title: LEISET CHUNGA CHENG MIJOUSEN
lyrics:
1. Leiset chunga cheng mijousen,
La ngei-in Pakai vahchoi-un,
A-angah kunun chibai un,
Kipah in hungun A-angah.

2. Eisempau Pathen Pakai chun,
Eina semun eivah jingui,
Eiho Ama a ihiuve,
Asemsa amite ihiu.

3. Vahchoi pumin A-ang jonun,
Kipah in nai un thanomin,
Vahchoi-un Amintheng chungnung,
Ibolding doltah cheh ahi.

4. Lei le van Pathen theng chungnung,
Amilungset tena neilou,
Tonsot a abang hijing jeng,
Kitah jing tonsot tonsot a.

title: EISEM’A EIHUHHING PAU CHU VAHCHOI-UN
lyrics:
1. Eisem’a eihuhhing pau chu vahchoi-un,
Lhan le thina konin eilhattauve.
Alet Aloupi jabollun vahchoi-un,
Huhhing hat loupi chungnung tah ahi.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahchoi jingun,
Chungnung pena loupi,
Chungnung chu vahchoi-un,
Vahchoi jingun,
Pakai le Leng chu vahchoi jingun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Eilungset eihonguva chu vahchoi-un,
I-kiselnao songpi le ikulpiu,
Eichinguva eikaihoi uva ahi,
Twidap lonna vahom phaicham lhunga.

3. Eisempau phat konna chu vahchoi cheh un,
Alet le Aloupina vahchoi-un,
Athu ging chauvin Alungset kinemun.
Angailutna eituh jing diuva chu.

title: PAKAI CHUNGNUNG JEHOVAH
lyrics:
1. Pakai chungnung Jehovah,
Na thu jaotah mong neilou,
Nang gam jousea leng ho Leng,
Tonsot Leng nangbou nahi.

2. Juda Gentile soh chamlhat,
Pumkhat hisoh ding Nang ah,
Messiah min pan cheh ding,
Angailut phongjal cheh diu.

3. China te imut khang diu,
Africa bul kilham ding,
Na mite hen vo Egypt,
Pathen Nangma vahchoi ding.

4. India gam hoi-a miten,
Na vahchoi la ngei sading,
Ceylon twikol mi'n sading,
'Leng Christa loupi hen' tia.

5. Vannoi chitin le namtin,
Lei lallukhuh laltouna,
Nangma anga kuncheh ding,
Leng ho Leng Pakai chungnung.

title: VO PATHEN CHUNGNUNG PEN KAHINVAH
lyrics:
1. Vo Pathen chungnung pen kahinvah choiye,
Hingjing Pathen le imajouse bolthei,
Lungdong soh genthei te mi chonse te jol,
Chaga te genthei te (3) Pakai le Pathen.

2. Mite taona sang Pathen nahijeh in,
Namiten asinmo athumnao pejing,
Nachate ka le ham na ngai lhi jinge,
Thudih a thilpha bol (3) Na nungsun ngaipoi.

3. Hiche hi milen le mineo hetsah in,
Mipite le nangma thu dou jing ho hi,
Tua huhhing a aum theina dinguva,
“Ipi kati diu ham?" (3) tiuhen lang Amen.

4. Namtin thim’a kon soh a kon kipah hen,
"Chungnung penna Pathen loupina hihen;
Leichunga kipah te chunga chamleng hen,
Hosanna" (6) sam in lan sauvin.

title: TONSOT TONSOT A PATHEN KEIMA
lyrics:
1. Tonsot tonsot a Pathen keima kaina,
Leiset kisem masang laipeh a umsa,
Nangma let thu chan seithei dinga koiham,
Nangma lung ngaito hepha dinga umlou.

2. Kum sangsom sangja Nangma dinga haini,
Hitichun Nangma phat umchan ka Pathen,
Keima hinkho vang ihmutlan mang bangin,
Niseh in akem jinge chemang loi ding.

3. Huinun a thingna louna apul bangin,
Nangma lunghan a mihemte thigam thei,
Hing kahi keima Nangma vanga Pathen,
Nangma louva keima ima titheilou.

4. Nalung hanna kon iti sochat ing-em?
Nang ginin hoija gakisel tangem kei?
Leng thei in twilen leng galkai le jong leng,
Chukom jong chu Nangma angsung ma hi ding.

title: ATHENG ATHENG ATHENG PATHEN HAT
lyrics:
1. Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! Pathen hat chungnungpen,
Jingpi tah in Nangma vahchoila kasauve,
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! mikhoto hat chungnung,
Athumin khat hi'n, khat chu thum ahi.

2. Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! van Mitheng te jousen,
A lhaijing-ui Ama chu tantih neilou vin,
Vantil asangja le van Mitheng te jousen,
A lhai jingui Ama tan neilou in.

3. Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! leiset mite vet a,
Nangma loupi akimu thei lou jeng vangin,
Nangma bou Athenga atheng adang umlou,
Theng le mi khoto lungset chamkim soh.

4. Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! Pathen hat chamkim soh,
Vannoi namtin jousen Nangma jeng bou lhai ding
Atheng, Atheng, Atheng! milungset hat chungnung,
Athumin khat hi'n, Khat chu thum ahi.

title: KIPAH UN PATHENA NOMUN
lyrics:
1. Kipah un Pathena nomun,
Lung thengsel Mithengte jouse;
Pathen chu gingun tahsanun,
Genthei gim lungdon pailhauvin.

[CHORUS_START]
Nomun ... ... Nomun,
Kipah un Pathen’a nomun;
Nomun ... ... Nomun,
Kipah un Pathen'a nomun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Nomun Ama Pakai ahi,
Vannoi leiset le van chunga;
Aman gam thum vaipi apoi,
Eihuhhing hatchungnung ahi.

3. Muthim in nang khu jong le chun,
Jan a vanpi nim bang jong le;
Ima lungdonna nei lou in,
Pathen jenga tahsan jingun.

4. Kipah un Pathen a nomun,
A vahchoina la ngei sauvin;
Sauvin na O sansah un lang,
Ao un Hallelujah tiuvin.

title: HUNGUN HUNGUN MITHENG JOUSE
lyrics:
1. Hungun hungun Mitheng jouse,
Pathen lhaina la saute,
Gingtah cheh in vahchoi cheh un,
Vanchunga Leng chungnung chu,
Hing jing Pathen pentil bei,
Lei le van Pakai ahi,
Ama sang a lendang umlou,
Ama bou tonsot Pathen.

2. Van le leiset noimi gamjong,
Chule simsenlou ahsi,
Nisa, lhathah le thil jouse,
Ama sem’a um ahi,
Ganhing ju le va jouse,
Khovah hoi le muthim jong,
Molle lhang dam phaicham twilen,
Chule mihemte jouse.

3. Van le lei sem, chunga Pathen,
Lengho Leng chungnung ahi,
Pakai jouse Pakai ahi,
Van le lei thempu chungnung,
Gin ding le ja ding ahi,
Van mi le leiset miten,
Vahchoi-ute chunga Pathen,
Tonsot in vahchoi-ute.

title: KAKIPAH E VAN’A KA- PA
lyrics:
1. Kakipah e van’a ka- Pa aum,
Athupha lungmonna thu eihile,
Athupha bua thu kidang tah kamui;
Hibang thupha Jesun eilungsetna.

[CHORUS_START]
Kakipah e, Jesun eilungset,
Kei eilungset, kei eilungset,
Kakipah-e, Jesun eilungset,
Kei jong eilungset e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ken Ama sumil- ing lamvai jong leng,
Mangta jong leng Aman eilungset e,
Aman eilungset ken kageldoh teng,
Kalut kit jitai Ama khut sunga.

3. Keiman langei khat ana sathei leng,
Leng loupi chungnung mel kamu nile,
Hichu hi ding ka tonsot chulmo la,
Jesun eilungsetna akidang e.

4. Kichen tah a lung monga kahitai,
Jesu tahsan a nomsa kahitai,
Kalunga kon satan ajam jitai,
Jesun eilungset keiman kasei teng.

title: VAHCHOI UN LOUPI LENG PATHEN
lyrics:
1. Vahchoi un Loupi Leng Pathen chungnung chu,
Vahchoi-un thil kidang eibol peh jal un,
Umpi jing eithutep ichenau chan a,
Meikou le meilom’a eipui le jal un.

[CHORUS_START]
Van Mitheng vah jousen,
Vahchoi vahchoi un,
Choi-an un amiten,
Amai mucheng chun,
A gam sung loupia chun,
Phat kitol laisen,
Anatoh ho jousen (2)
Pathen vahchoi cheh ding,
Kalhan vahchoi jin.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Vahchoi jun manbei a mijouse alhat,
Hinna twinah eipe, eidamsah thei chu,
Eilungset eihepiu, lungset na jal in,
Itaonau asange ti kichet jal in.

3. Vahchoiyun lungsetna gui eilhah-uva,
Van chunga thilpha toh eikan gom-uva,
Tahsan a gal jona kinepna vah jing,
Ingai cheng chenkhom na Agam nom ahi.

title: EIHUHHINGPAN EIPUILEN EICHINGNAI
lyrics:
1. Eihuhhingpan eipuilen eichingnai,
Itobang hung lhung jongle kahoiye,
Hui le go kitho na a eisel ding,
Akhut phang kom tong sungah.

[CHORUS_START]
Akhut phang kom tong sunga (2)
Itobang hung lhung jongle kahoiye,
Akhut phang kom tong sungah.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ami lungset ban’in kei eikoiye,
Avan lung monna thu'n eilha mon e,
Pathen khut in eikoiyin kahoiye,
Akhut phang kom tong sungah.

3. A lungsetna ken sumil jou lou ding,
Ka Pathen toh eikhen jou ding umlou,
Itih chan hijong le eilha lou ding,
Akhut phang kom tong sungah.

title: KAMIT'IN PAKAI HUNGNA DING LOUPI
lyrics:
1. Kamit'in Pakai hungna ding loupi tah chu amutai,
Lunghana lengpi theiga kikholla chu chilngim dingin,
Aman kolphe banga man gang tah chemjam chu alamtai,
Pathen a gal kon’e.

[CHORUS_START]
Aloupita! Hallelujah
Aloupita! Hallelujah
Aloupita! Hallelujah
Pathen a gal kon'e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Simsenlou sepai galkappet ve-a ding Pakai kamui,
Nilhah dainou lah a Ama din Maicham asahpeh un,
Achonphat thulhun chu meivah pha bangin kasim theije,
Pathen agal kon'e.

3. Hung kinung tollun tilou hel dingin sumkon amuttai,
Athupi tan masanga mihemte lung akhen sohding;
Gang in kalha Ama donbut ding thanom in ka khophang,
Pathen a gal kon'e.

4. Twikhanglen gal'a Lily hoi lah a Christa peng ahi,
Ama anga loupi tah a nang le kei ivou kikhel;
Mi thenna dia Athi bangin thiu hite mi hinna din,
Pathen a gal kon'e.

title: LAM NEIHILLIN O JEHOVAH
lyrics:
1. Lam neihillin O Jehovah,
Hiche leiset gamthim’a
Pathen Nangma hatchungnung in,
Nei huhhing in lungdonna.
Van’a konin, Van’a konin,
Hinna an chun neivah in. (2)

2. Pathen keima neihon peh in,
Hinna twinah kemlou chu,
Nalhagao chun neipui le'n lang,
Kamasang sanga che hen.
Hatchungnung in, hatchungnung in,
Nei huhhing in kei Jesu'n. (2)

3. Jordan twipi gal kakai a,
Hi leiset ka dalhah teng,
Kalung donna sumang soh in,
Nei puilhung tei-in vangam.
Na vahchoi la, Na vahchoi la,
Kemmon sange nitinin. (2)

title: EDEN HON'A PATHEN IN
lyrics:
1. Eden hon'a Pathen in,
Anasem in nu le pa,
Ana gomin lultah in,
Phattheina tincheng apei.

[CHORUS_START]
Pathen Adam le Eve
Nana gomin pentil in,
Tun jong hiteni gomin,
Phat theina cham kim in pen.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pentil thu umchan bang in,
Akichengtai hiteni,
Anu Apa hinda lhan,
Kikhen kit tih neilou din.

3. Kilungset to geltah in,
Kivahto jing jeng lhon hen,
Apheu alhau khat hihen,
Lung khatin in cheng lhon hen.

4. Pathen hou-in kumtu hen
Chung gam ajot teng jongleh,
Munkhat a kaltou lhon hen,
Vangam nom’a cheng dingin.

title: KAPA NANGMA LAM KASANG E
lyrics:
1. Kapa Nangma lam kasang e,
Eihu ding dang umlou,
Nei dalhan kichon mang le chun,
Hoija iti tang-em?

[CHORUS_START]
Katahsan'e, katahsan'e,
Kei jal'a Jesu thi,
Ama thisan lutah a chun,
Ka chonset theng soh ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Nachapa Jesun athoh in,
Kahai thei masang in,
Nat thohlel gimna athohtai,
Ka lhagao huhhing na'n.

3. Jesu Nang katahsan thei tai,
Na thahat chu kahei;
Ka ngaichat jouse tun neipen,
Kalung kipah jing hen.

4. Jesu Nangma lam kasang-e,
Kamit khamna neiven,
Neipen na thilpha lutah chu,
Hibou chu kahinna.

title: KA PATHEN NANGMA KOM
lyrics:
1. Ka Pathen Nangma kom
Kahung naije,
Gim genthei lungdonna,
Toh jeng jong leng.
Navahchoi la sange,
Na kom kahung naije,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom
Kahung naije.

2. Kho jinghen thim jongle
Neilhon pin lang,
Vah hen thim jeng jong le,
Nei puilhung in,
Katah in kamang in,
Na kom nai kanom'e,
Na kom cheh a Pathen,
Ka hung naiye,

3. Van jotna van lampi
Hin lhung lhan lang,
Van kalbi hin lah in,
Nei lungset in,
Na vantil hinsol lhan,
Ei pui lhung pai dingin,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom
Ka hung naije.

4. Lung jina kon ka thoa,
Ka lung halteng,
Pathen Nang vahchoi la,
Keiman sang-e,
Kahung e nei sangin,
Neilan neichul nam-in,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom
Ka hung naiye.

5. Len theina ving neijing,
Kipah tah in,
Nisa sanga sang jon
Leng sang jong leng,
Hiche la hi mang mon,
Na vahchoi nan sang-e,
Ka Pathen Nangma kom
Ka hung naiye.

title: CHENA VANA HOIMA JOUSEA
lyrics:
1. Chena vana hoima jousea
Pathen in eipui le jing nai,
Lunggel le natohna jouse a,
Pathen in eipui le jing nai.

[CHORUS_START]
Pathen in eipui le jing nai,
Ama khut tah in eikai lei,
Aseijui tahsan kichen tah,
Hi'nge eipui le jing jeh-in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Lung jin lungdon nat thoh lelna,
Genthei nan eibom jeng jong le,
A van thupha hinna thu chun,
Eipui len eilhem lung mong e.

3. Hahsa toh ing nom toh jong leng,
Twihat le twinem pal jong leng,
Eden hon nom a leng jong leng,
Pathen in eipui le jing nai.

4. Kathi teng keima Pathen in,
Jordan lui eipui galkai ding,
Van innom’a cheng jing tange,
Olmo lou Aman eipuinai.

title: VO PATHEN NANGMA
lyrics:
1. Vo Pathen Nangma,
Vahchoi la kasauve,
Eihuhhing din Nachapa nahinsol lhai;

[CHORUS_START]
Hallelujah ! Nang na loupi,
Hallelujah ! Amen !
Hallelujah ! Nang na loupi !
[CHORUS_END]

2. Lhagao Theng vangin,
La kasauve Pathen,
Jesu chun eihilun mu thim apai lhai.

3. Loupina jouse,
Kelngoi nou thisanin,
Mi chonsetna jouse apo mang sohtai.

4. Kalung suhalin,
Ngailutnan lo soh hen,
Mi jouse lunga ngailut meiyin kong hen;

5. Pentecost nia bang chun,
Lhagao Theng hung kumlhan
Mi lungsung jousea mei bangin hungkong hen;

title: TONSOT SONGPI KADINGA
lyrics:
1. Tonsot songpi kadinga,
Khia chun Nanga neisel in,
Nanah thenga hung long doh,
Longlha thisan le twi chun,
Ka chonset neisop thengin,
Nei huhhing in keima tun.

2. Kakhut in na tong jong leng,
Ka mitlhi long jeng jongleh,
Lung nunin gunchu jong leng,
Nangma chondan thupeh chu,
Keiman jui kim jou lou ding,
Ka chonset theng thei lou ding.

3. Ima kahin choipoi ken,
Cross jeng a chu kingaija,
Ponsillou ponsil dinga,
Nangma kom hinbel kahi,
Nei huhhingin lengvai kei,
Chonsetna thi ding kahi.

4. Hiche lung kagel laihin,
Thinan kamit asin a,
Hi leiset kagal kaija,
Na thupi tan kamu teng,
Tonsot songpi'n neihuh in.
Neisel'in nei huhhingin.

title: VO KA PATHEN LUNGSET TAH
lyrics:
1. Vo ka Pathen lungset tah in,
Kachonsetna sumang soh in,
Na milungset simthei lou chun,
Kachonset simthei lou soplhan.

2. Kakisem’a chonsea hung peng,
Chonse pan kei kanu sunga,
Hijeh chun ka chonset soplhan,
Neiban sah in buhbang bang in.

3. Ka Pathen nei jah sah kit in,
Nang a kon lung halna thupha,
Kalung gelna kagu bongsa,
Jong chu kipa'n kijom kit hen.

4. Lungtheng lungnem athah neipen,
Kalunga lhagao theng cheng hen,
Chuteng Thupha seiphong leng-e,
Mi chonse lamvaite heng-ah.

5. Vo Pathen, Nang mi huhhingna,
Thupha chu keiman lan sang-e,
Nangma min ngei vahchoina chu,
Keiman seileng'e nitin in.

title: KA PATHEN KEI MI CHONSE
lyrics:
1. Ka Pathen kei mi chonse,
Kahung taove naheng-a,
Pathen nei engbol hih in,
Kachon khelna ngaidam in.

2. Mi khoto chungnung Pathen,
Kathoh hesoh kho neiton,
Ka mitlhi long theh hul'in,
Kanat thohlel subeijin.

3. Thempu jouse Thempu Nang,
Pakai ho Pakai nahi,
Hinna damna lungmon na,
Nang louva hing thei umlou.

4. Pathen hung kihei kit in,
Kalha dammo huhhing in,
Pathen kahet jing theinan,
Nei damsah in tuchung hin.

title: PATHEN NANGMA HOUBUNG MITE
lyrics:
1. Pathen Nangma Houbung mite,
Lungset in phattheina pen,
Namai vah chun salvah soh in,
Ka lah-uva kilang hen.

[CHORUS_START]
Chutile vannoi leiset mi'n,
Muntin Nangma Thupha theng hi,
Vannoi namtin le phung tinin,
Gam jousen hinna tante.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Vo Pathen Nangma vahchoi la,
A mihem jousen sauhen,
Mi asangja O gin thong chun,
Vannoi leiset losoh hen.

[CHORUS_START]
Mi sutheng thei na hi nangma,
Na gam loupi chu hinlah in,
Vannoi leiset gam kimvella,
Chonsetna son mang soh in.
[CHORUS_END]

3. Vo Pathen kataona sangin,
Van Lhagao theng hinsollin,
Nagam kachalsah nadiuvin,
Houbung mite tha hinpen.

[CHORUS_START]
Pathen phattheina neipeuvin,
Niseh in nei kithopiuvin,
Chuteng vannoi leiset miten,
Na loupi hetauvinte.
[CHORUS_END]

title: NILE LHAVAH ANGAIPOI
lyrics:
1. Nile lhavah angaipoi,
Mitheng te chenna chu,
Chua setna um talou,
Pathen chenna ahi.

[CHORUS_START]
Chu gam nom chu,
Mitin kinepna ahi,
Lhandampu lenna ichenna diu,
Mitin kinepna ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Lungdon lungjin umta lou,
Cholte kitha olta,
Vanvou thah in lhaisel in,
Chugam’a aleng-ui.

3. Chu gam khopi emhoi chu,
Kul le kotpi emsel,
Kelngoinou vah in sal in,
Sun le jan umta lou.

title: EILHANDAMPU NEISAL VAHNA
lyrics:
1. Eilhandampu neisal vahna,
Na Lhagao le na lungset na,
Akidange! neilungset na,
Kei ding ahi-e aboncha.

[CHORUS_START]
Eilhandampu hithei nang-em?
Longlhen theng gan kihing lha bang,
A-itih a tonsot geiya,
Nangma dingin hithei nang-em?
[CHORUS_END]

2. Na mite huhhingna dingin,
Na thoh in na long na toh-e,
Genthei nathoh Gethsemania,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

3. Nalu theng tah ling in sunta,
Eihuhhing nan thisan along,
Calvary Cross kidang tah chu,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

4. Cham le lungset ahao ngeije,
Na van gam dim, gou le thil lu,
Manbei ja lungset tonsotna,
Kei ding ahiye aboncha.

title: PATHEN NANGMA LHAIDIN
lyrics:
1. Pathen Nangma lhaidin,
Kakai khom kit tauve,
Nei nung sun lou jen-un Pathen,
Ka chonset jeng vang un.

2. Ka chonset apum pin,
Kahinpoi na heng ah,
Na ngaidam ding le soptheng din,
Nakom kahin bel’e.

3. Ka chonset simthei lou,
Sapset thei kahiuve,
Hi jongleh Nangma milungset,
Hat jon sumang soh-in.

4. Hijehchun katao nau,
Ngaijin lungtheng homin,
Leiset lungngai sumang soh-in,
Chonphat lung nei peuvin.

5. Pathen hou thanom chu,
Vangpha le nom chungnung,
Athi teng van’a cheng jing ding,
Van Mitheng nom lai-a.

title: ITI NOPTAM PATHEN LHAIPET
lyrics:
1. Iti noptam Pathen lhaipet,
Leiset lungngai lung a beita,
I-ngai jouse kim in eipei,
Van’a Pa Laltouna konin,
Satan gal’in lam eipel tai,
Ka taopetna Nang na hung le,
Ka lungdon lungjin pet jongle,
Kalung mon le kipa'n aloi.

2. Iti noptam Pathen lhai pet,
Vantil kei dinga hungpa chun,
Ka taona Pathen ang-sungah,
Na lhaving in potou vin lang,
Pan eilungsetna thu kajai,
A thupha dihtah chu kahei,
Kalung apumpin kapetai,
Hung kumlhan tun ka taopet hin.

3. Iti noptam Pathen lhaipet,
Nang a kona lungmon na thu,
Kalung sunga hin khum dim-in,
Van innom kahung lhun kahsen,
Ka leiset vou kapai lhah a,
Kemlou van vou chu ka chan teng;
Ka len thoa vanjol kagei teng,
Kalhai kalhai leiset ting-e.

title: NANGMA KANGAI JING-E
lyrics:
1. Nangma kangai jing-e,
Lungset Pakai,
Na kam ngei O dam chun,
Eilung mon thei.

[CHORUS_START]
Kangaiye Nang kangaije,
Phat-tin nidan tin-in,
Phat theina neipen Jesu,
Tun ka hung-e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Nangma kangai jinge,
Nei ngah jing in,
Lhepnan eijou lou ding,
Nei umpi le.

3. Nangma kangai jinge,
Gim le nopna,
Nangma beija keima,
Hing jou lou ding.

4. Nangma kangai jing-e,
Lungtheng neipen,
Kachunga nalung chan
Bulhit soh-in.

5. Niseh in kangaiye,
Vo ka Pathen,
Nangman cha'n nei sem,

title: PAKAI PHAT THEINAN NEILHAUVIN
lyrics:
1. Pakai phat theinan neilhauvin,
Kalung kipa dimsah in,
Nang ngailutna lung nei peuvin,
Khat cheh in neilung set un,
Neithah sem-un tha neipeuvin,
Gamthim kajot laiseuvin.

2. Thangvah to thon ka choi-an-ui,
Na Thupha neipeh jal un,
Na mi huhhingna ga pung hen,
Leiya kahin laiseuvin,
Tahsan umtah tah neisou-vin,
Hiu ving-e tahsan jing Nang.

3. Chuti chun van thu hung lhun a
Keiho cheng nei kou teng leh,
Vantil eipui tou ding hung chu,
Anung jui ding kipah a
Christa toh vai homkhom theinan,
Tonsot kemlou vangam a.

title: HUNG KUMLHAN LHA-THENG VAN VAKHU
lyrics:
1. Hung kumlhan Lha-theng van vakhu,
Bu hungsan kalung a,
Kalung a Pathen ngailutna,
Khum in meiyin kong hen.

2. Leiset lungngai len thang sunga,
Kalung a cheng den-in,
Tonsot nopna lam a kalung,
Akaltou jou tapoi.

3. Kala sah jong phatchomna bei,
Haldohna umdeh lou,
Nop la jong kasa chim jitai,
Ka tahsan lhom jeh in.

4. Ka ngai Pathen itih chan kei,
Hitia ka um ding ham?
Nangman nei lungset simthei lou,
Nalung katona bei.

5. Vo Lha-theng van vakhu hungin,
Ka lung ah hung busan,
Lungtheng lungnem lungdih khum in,
Ka lung ah cheng den-in.

title: NGAIJUN VANTIL HO LASAH
lyrics:
1. Ngaijun vantil ho lasah,
“Leng pengthah chu loupi hen”

Pathen le mi chonse ho;
A kihou cham kit tauve,

Van lasa ho chu jom-un,
Bethlehem kho sunga chun,
Christa chu ahung pengtai,
“Leng pengthah chu loupi hen!”

2. Chungnung pen in avahchoi,
Christa tonsot Pakai chu,
Ahung pen ding kiseisa,

Leiset mihem naosen in,
Leiset mitoh cheng khom din,
Jesu Immanual chu;
Mihem in ahung pengtai,
“Leng pengthah chu loupi hen!”

3. Chamna Leng chu vahchoiyun,
Vahchoiyun nisoh thah chu,
Hinna khovah ahinpoi,
Alhaving japdam theina,
Aloupina hin dalha'n,
Mihem te sochat na din,
Leiset mite tung doh din,
Penthah kit thu ahinpoi,
Mihem in ahung peng-e,
“Leng pengthah chu loupi hen!”

title: KELNGOI CHING HON JANKHANG LAIYIN
lyrics:
1. Kelngoi ching hon jankhang laiyin,
A kelngoi nga pet-un,
Pakai vantil ahung kumlhan,
A salvah soh jeng-e.

2. Vantil chun kicha hih-uvin,
Keima neimu jeh un,
Kipana Thupha kahinpoi,

3. David Leng phung a apenge,

4. "Cheleu chun gan ankong sung ah,

5. Asei jou-in,Vantil ho chun,

6. "Chungnung a Pathen loupi hen,

lyrics:

lyrics:

lyrics:

lyrics:
1. Jesu min hi iti ngeitam,

lyrics:

Chonset keuna athisan tahsan chan chu,
Tonsot hinkem lou anei tei ding ahi,
Aman huhhingna thahat anei jeh chun.

3. Koi hile alung hei-a chonset pailha,
Pakai lutna ding a lungkot hong a chun,
A huhhing chamkim’a nomsa ding ahi.
Huhhing ding sadem’a um ahijeh chun.

title: CHONSE SUGENTHEI LHAGAO HO
lyrics:
1. Chonse sugenthei Lhagao ho,
Jesu tahsan leu chun,
Aman olsah tauvin nate,
Athu tahsan leu chun.

[CHORUS_START]
Tahsan jeng un, tahsan jengun,
Tahsan jeng un tun,
Huhhing tei ding, huhhing tei ding,
Nang na huhhing ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesun athisan lu ason,
Hinna nom eipeove,
Thisan lui-ah chun kiphum un,
Buh bang a sop bang ding.

3. Jesu lampi dihtah ahi,
Olna gam nom jotna,
Geisang louvin tahsan loijin,
Phatthei na chan kim ding.

4. Ahile gam loupi jonin,
Hung lhauvin loi theng a,
Gam loupia innom’a cheng din,
Nop kemlou van inah.

title: NAGA CHE NAM NANGMA JESU
lyrics:
1. Naga che nam nangma Jesu heng a chu?
A thisan in na kisop theng nam ?
Ami lungset na chun nakinem nam nang?
Athisan in na kisop theng nam ?

[CHORUS_START]
A thisan .......theng a chun,
Na chonset nasop theng soh nah em ?
Navon nen chu kicheh a ngimsel soh nam ?
A thisan chun na kisop theng nam ?
[CHORUS_END]

2. Niseh in Jesu kom’a naum jing nam ?
Thisan a na kisop theng hinam ?
Ama chu lungmon na nanei nam nangma,
A thisan in na kisop theng nam ?

3. Hung toh nan tem ahung nile Moulang chun,
A thisan na navon athen soh,
Phasa dem nan tem nalha van’a kaldin,
A thisan in na kisop theng nam?

4. Na chonset nen bena navon chu pailhan,
A thisan in kisil thengin tun,
Nang ding in hinna twidung khat along e,
Hia chun na chonset soptheng tan.

title: TONSOT A CHENNA DING
lyrics:
1. Tonsot a chenna ding,
Hoilai-a in sa nahim?
Khopi hui mut lhuh theina ham?
Chonset neldi chung hintem?

[CHORUS_START]
Song chung a hin hungsan,
In hungsan apang det din,
Christa jeng bou, Christa jeng bou,
Sochatna songpi ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Khopi hui anun’a,
Na in ahin nuh teng leh,
Nellei chung a insa nangma,
Lung mong in umnan natem ?

3. Khopi hui nunkah in,
Inmun det ding ki ngaiton,
Na lung gellin hungsan tuman.
Longlou songpi chung a hin.

title: VEUVIN IHINNA DING UN JESU
lyrics:
1. Veuvin ihinna ding un Jesu Cross chung a,
Eihuh nan athisan along lhai,
Ven, mi chonsen tun ven ki huhhing sah loi-in,
Nangma huhna along tohpa chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Ven! ven! ven hing in,
Hinna ding a Cross chung a kikhenbeh Jesu,
Genthei tah in athi nang chu nan.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Hung un mi chonsen hung ven na hinna ding un,
Cross chung a um Jesu khu tunin,
Jesu hilou nasam gim le genthei thoh a,
Tonsot hinkem lou nang napea chu.

3. Na chonset na jouse hinpon Jesu kom’a,
Hung seplhan Ama soptheng ding in,
Thonmon soplhante Aman athisan lu chun,
Theng tante na chonset nen jouse.

4. Chonset mu thim’a hitih chanpi na ihmun,
Na um jing e Ama helouvin,
Vo michonse tun hungin Jesu henga chun,
Khatvei hungven na sochat na ding.

title: “KA HENG A HUNG-UVIN” ATI
lyrics:
1. “Ka heng a hung-uvin” ati Jesun,
Hinna Pakai na lung kipa sah chun,
“Lungkham’a lung genthei-a umte ho,
Ka hengah hung un ken olsah inge”.

[CHORUS_START]
Hung un keima heng a hung un,
Ka hengah hung un keiman olsah inge,
Keiman ol penge, keiman ol peng e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Chonset pohna a pohgih lengvai ho,
Jesun na khoton na kou-vui hungun,
Na lungdon hesoh beisoh na dingin,
“ Ka heng a hung un keiman ol penge”.

3. Chonset le suhkhel a thi ding kon ho,
Khang un Pathen kichauvin lung gel’un,
Na tahsanmo pailhan tahsan in tun,
“Ka heng a hung un keiman ol penge”.

title: JESUN NA KOU KOU LAI
lyrics:
1. Jesun na kou kou lai hin, chonse hung in,
Nang ding a katao lai hin, chonse hung in,
Sopi ngaiten nakou-ui, chonse hung in,
Ama kouna ngai-in lang, chonse hung in.

2. Ama neiphat tu ahi, chonse hung in,
Ama hetphat tu ahi, chonse hung in.
Na chonset poh nalel em, chonse hung in,
Jesun napoh ngai jang ding, chonse hung in,
Jesun nang dalha lou ding, chonse hung in,
Jesun tun nang na sang e, chonse hung in.

3. Ama lungset sung a chun, chonse hung in,
Phattheina hung kisan in, chonse hung in,
Jesun nakou petcha hin, chonse hung in,
Nang katao peh pet u hin, chonse hung in.

title: HUNG KIHEI JIN VAHMANGSA LUNG
lyrics:
1. Hung kihei jin vahmangsa lung genthei,
Ven Jesu Christan na ching jing e nang,
Na hol’in na ngah’e huhhing ding in.
Geisang lou vin Ama tahsan loi-in.

[CHORUS_START]
Lungdam sel’in na kouve nang Jesun,
Phaten ngai in Jesun na kou chu,
Lung lhaisel’in na kouve nang Jesun,
“Hung un” tin lungset in eikou-ui.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Na man louna ding in na ngah jing e,
Hitih chan nangma vahmang a nahi,
Nangma chu-nan thi genthei athohtai,
Ami ngailut kidang chu seithei lou.

3. A thu ngaijin lang alungset na hen,
Cross chung a na chonset a pomang tai,
Tonsot hinkem lou chu namusah tai
Na chonset jouse angaidam soh tai.

4. Hungin lamlui lamdih hung jot kit in,
Hinna kotpi Jesua hung lut loi-in,
Lung lhaisel’in na kouve nang Jesun,
Lhachom kit talou ding nang a kom’a.

title: DAMSEL CHAN KA TONG LHUM
lyrics:
1. Damsel chan ka tong lhum ui,
Hiche nigup sung a hin,
Kakikhom tauve, tunin,
Pathen lhai la kasauve,
Hiche Pathen nipha hi,
Van tonsot ol kihetna.

2. Mi lungset them a Jesu,
Ka set nau soptheng soh in,
Chonse ho taona ngai in,
Ka khelnao ngaidam soh in,
Beihen leiset lung ngaina,
Ka lung u Nang a kaihen.

3. Nangma ka lhaipet chau hin,
Ka lungu sunem soh in,
Hiche Hou-in theng a hin,
Hung kiphong in Pathen Nang,
Van’a kon an kemlou chu,
Keiho neihin pe cheh un.

title: GAMTU THIM NOIYA NAVALE
lyrics:
1. Gamtu thim noiya navale.
Jin le hoiya ding nahim ?
Leiset gamthim lai najot chu,
Nalung olmo lou hinam ?

[CHORUS_START]
Vanchung gam jon kahiuve,
Hung kipat in lhonu hite;
Pathen min vahchoiyu hite.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Kahinai ‘Jinle’ neiti chu.
Ahivanga olmo lou;
Eiching pau to kalhon nai kei,
Ama vang chu kasong e.

3. Hoiya um’am na lamkai pau,
Kamu hih in ka olmoi;
Chutia nachingpa aumle,
Ama la akimu pon.

4. Heng kimu lou ahivanga,
Eipuile phatah ahi;
Gimna jousea eihuh in kei,
Kagal asumang sohji,

5. Jingle nalampi masanga,
Vetan nathina ding chun;
Nangma hinchup jeng tale chun,
Nache tei ngam ding hinam ?

title: HUNG UN GEL’UN SOPI TE
lyrics:
1. Hung un gel’un Sopi te, Jesun eilungsetna,
I-chonset suhmang na din, I-lung u ngaitoute.

[CHORUS_START]
I ding lung phamo ihim,
I lung thoina iham?
I monau phong jal leuhen,
Aman subei tante.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Keima Christa tahsan sa, Ama lam sangsa hing,
Kalung thoi kittan keima, tun ka lung olmo tai.

[CHORUS_START]
Twilen sohbang lung detlou,
Mi lengvai olmo jing,
Tha neilou mi dammo ken,
Hoija olna mung-em ?
[CHORUS_END]

3. Hijong le na huhhingpa, Gethsemania ngaiton,
Nang chonset pohmang na a, athisan ul’a long.

[CHORUS_START]
Thingpel’a aum pet chun,
A thisan a long lhai,
Nang chonset jal in athi,
Henge tun tahsan tan.
[CHORUS_END]

4. Lungin tunjong a tahsan, lou nahi nah lai yem ?
A khophang bula kunin, ichonset beina din.

[CHORUS_START]
Chuto bang Jesu chu ken,
Nahsah mon ngai ponge;
Kathi nung le Akoma.
Kalut jel theina din.
[CHORUS_END]

title: ZION MOLSANG CHUNG VUM’A
lyrics:
1. Zion molsang chung vum’a
Gal upa thithei louvin,
Eikou ui galsat dingin,
Gal sat-a umte.

[CHORUS_START]
Ngaiyun sumkon gin ngei khu,
Veuvin Pathen ponlap khu,
Gal sangja ahung nai tai,
Chem le thal dom in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Hung un mi chonse chate,
Sochatna ding lung pu-vin,
I dougal a sumang tai,
I lamkai Jesun.

[CHORUS_START]
Lhan sung a nithum cham in,
Thina dougal sat chai jin,
Loupi tah min len tah in,
A kaltou kit tai.
[CHORUS_END]

3. Leiset mihem mai vea,
Pathen mit’a jahcha pa,
Galsat petna kisel chun,
Ka nung juida hen.

[CHORUS_START]
Nu le pa, sopi dalha,
Thal le hem lah nohngam pa,
Thi le man kicha lou pan,
Ka nung hin jui hen.
[CHORUS_END]

4. Kon ute galsat ding in,
Theu hite Satan loi chu,
Theu hite dana gam chu,
Chonset pailhau te.

[CHORUS_START]
Nopna munnom tup ute,
Nop le ol kem louna chu,
Mang thei lou Pathen gam’a,
Lut teiding goute.
[CHORUS_END]

title: GAL SAM UN SATAN GAL
lyrics:
1. Gal sam un Satan gal ahung nai tai,
Christa din ponlap domsang un,
Galvon kivon un ding det cheh uvin,
A thutheng chu lum le phon sung in.

[CHORUS_START]
Kon un galmi loi kisem toh un lang,
Pang det cheh un thu hi bantol un,
Malam no-uvin Hosanna tin ao-vun,
Christa gal lamkai pipen ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Gal hahsa hen lang itobang jong leh,
I jo tei diu ahi thon mo-a,
Khovah lum sung un Lhagao chem pan un,
Jona chu eiho chan ding ahi.

3. Vo! Vannoi Pathen, ka kounau ngai jin,
Nei huvin na mi lungset chun,
Galsat kichai ja gal kijo teng le,
Lallukhuh kasan theina ding un.

title: CHRISTIAN SEPAI KONUN GAL SAT
lyrics:
1. Christian sepai konun, gal sat din cheuvin,
Jesu lamjeng veuvin, I lamkai pau chu;
Leng Christa akontai, satan galsat din,
Ama alamkaitai ponlap che veuvin.

[CHORUS_START]
Christian sepai konun,
Satan galsat din;
Jesu lam jeng veuvin,
I-Lamkaipau chu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Galmi janel banga Pathen mite kon,
Mi theng ho che na nungjui-ah ihiuve;
Achom chom iumpoi, iboncha pumkhat,
Ikinepnao jong khat ikainau khat bou.

3. Leiset leng ho gam le, alalnau mang ding,
Christa Houbung vang chu, mantih neilou ding,
Gim hesoh, lungdonna, kiseikit lou ding,
Atonsot tonsot’a, Christa vaihom ding.

title: LHUMLAM GAM’A KONIN
lyrics:
1. Lhumlam gam’a konin,
Thu ahung thang lhung e,
Hichu Christa lam’a tahpanna thu ahi,
A hung kitol tol in,
Thinglhang in lan asai,
Christa lam’a dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.

[CHORUS_START]
Gal jona ding in (2)
Pakai jin kho asam’e,
A thun chon’u hite,
Gam lo loitau hite,
Christa lam’a dettah a,
Tah panna thu ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ngai-juvin aw gin chu,
Leiset hotling soh O,
Hichu Christa lam’a tahpanna thu ahi,
Hang tah in tong pan’un,
Kigin nan kho sam-un,
Christa lam’a dettah a tahpanna thu ahi,

3. Khangdong tha kapan-ui,
Tunin Jesu ang ah,
Hichu Christa lam’a tahpanna thu ahi,
A thupha phong leu te,
Vannoi mi gam jousea,
Christa lam’a dettah a tahpanna thu ahi.

title: VAN’A LENGPA PONLAP AHUNG LENG
lyrics:
1. Van’a Lengpa ponlap ahung leng lhatai,
Van Leng sepaite heng ah,
Olmo louvin domsang u hite, tunin,
La isah ngei pet u hin.

[CHORUS_START]
Hung-uvin, hung-uvin,
Christa jal’in mang jong leu hen,
Khuhsah un Lallukhuh hoi chu,
Thingpel ponlap noilim’a.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Twipi nong bang melma hung kitol jong le,
Ponlap leh sang jing un lang,
A lim noi-ah umun Pakai sepai te,
Thonlou-va eima jo ding.

3. Twi le leiset chung a mihem cheng jousen,
Hilsoh un hiche Thupha,
Hiche thisan ponlap van’a lenglha chu,
Pakai galjo kithan na.

4. Nopna khovah loupi ni ahung nai tai,
Niseh in ahung naitai,
Chuteng Leng ang a dougal beisoh ta ding,
Vannoi Cross in khokhong ding.

title: GAMLA NAIJA KON CHRISTIAN TE
lyrics:
1. Gamla naija kon Christian te,
Hikom’a ikikhomui tun,
Jesu thu kihil a simdin,
Van kipa kinep dimset chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Eiho hapan loi hin, Amin’a kikhom min,
Lungkhat le thakhat in Amin phongjal leu te,
Pathen le i-gamsung din pangdet cheh ute,
Phattheina a eichin jing na ding un taovun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. A kikhom sen lan sau hite,
I-Lengpau Christa vahchoi la,
Khang dong in lam amu na din,
Hinna gam jotna lampi chu.

3. Pakai na tong jing u hite,
Kitepna ineisau ngaiton,
Alungset gingchan jui ute,
Chung a iki khop kah seuvin.

title: PAKAI CHRISTA VANG IN DANTHU
lyrics:
1. Pakai Christa vang in danthu nung jui-jin,
Hinkemlou chu Ama vahchoina ding in,
Kipah le thanom tah in vahchoi cheh un,
Pakai danthu nungjuijin sauvin.

[CHORUS_START]
Ding un! Ding un!
Pakai Jesu a dingun athutep jui-un,
Ding un! Ding un!
Pakai thutep jui-in ka dinge kei.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Danthu jui chu i-matih in lhapong e,
Lhahchomna le kichat na Aman eihoi,
Mantih neilou thu chu Ama a ahi,
Pakai danthu jui-in ding uvin.

3. A thu nungjui ding keima olmo lou ding,
Lhagao Theng in eikou chu ken ngai jing ding,
Tonsot in Pakai vahchoi in ol tang e,
Pakai nopna chun um jing tange.

title: HUNG UN CHRISTIAN TE LUNGKHAT
lyrics:
1. Hung un Christian te lungkhat hiu hitin,
Seiphong leute sochatna Thupha,
Thinglhang gamsung a mi acheng jouse,
Satan bulpuvin akum tu’ve.

[CHORUS_START]
Hungun Christian te itha gom tou tin,
Sumang dingin idou Satan hat,
Hungun Christian te tha gom tou hitin,
I thahat pen nau Jesu umna.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Mi sangja hijat hinna thu mulou,
Vetem tauvin akihen nau bul;
Bulpu ngaiton lang i-nop pailhauvin,
Gasut lhammute bulpute chu.

3. Hung un sopite lung thah semu tin,
Chal sahna din Pakai Jesu gam;
Kihabol cheh un tantih neilouvin,
Ni loupi nia pam chan louna din.

title: VANCHUNG GAMNOM EMHOI TAH A
lyrics:
1. Vanchung gamnom emhoi tah a,
Chun vantil ten la asai,
Hallelujah Hosanna tin,
Asam-ui Leng vahchoi nan,
Hi leiset genthei mun’a konin,
Pakai jin eipui len,
Gang tah in ka jon’uve,
Vanchung gamnom emhoi tah chu.

[CHORUS_START]
O chu gam ilhun teng le,
Sana lukhuh isan diu,
Kipah le thanom tah a,
Chugam nom em’a ilendiu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Vanchung gamnom emhoi jon chun,
Nitin mi ache jinge,
Eiho jong chu gam lhunna ding,
Nikhon eihin nai-uve.
Jesu heng lam jon ihiuve,
Ama toh leng khom ding in,
Hiche gam’a chu tonsot a
Ama kivahchoi ta ding.

3. Chu gam innom hoitah a chun,
Mitin din inmun aum,
Lhandampu tahsan jouse le,
Kouna ngai jouse ding in,
Pakai thupeh hung lhun phat le,
Kipana hung lhung ta ding,
Chuteng hi leiset dalha gam.
Nom hoitah chu ijot diu.

title: A MANG KON HUHDOH IN
lyrics:
1. A mang kon huhdoh in athikon ngaiton,
Chonse khuh a konin ladoh loi-jin,
Chonkhel te chu hil’in alhu kaithou vin,
Huhhing Pakai Jesu thu seipeh in.

[CHORUS_START]
Amang kon huhdoh in athikon ngaiton,
Mi lungset them Jesun huhhing tei ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ama hon angaisah lou hel vang uvin,
Aman angah jing e lung neng tah in,
Avel vel’in damheu chan a kou jing e,
Tahsan pouleu a ngaidam ding ahi.

3. Mihem te lungsung setnan alodim tai,
Hijeh chun Pakai leija ahung e,
Lungset khut in atham’in asukhang in,
Athisa jong ahin sah kit jitai.

4. Amang kon huhdoh in nangma kin ahi,
Pakaiyin nangma thahat pen na te,
Lhagao mang ding mi sangja aum-uve,
Huhhing pan a lungset nau thu hil’in.

title: CHRISTA MI LUNGSET SEILEU TE
lyrics:
1. Christa mi lungset seileu te,
A lungset len,
Leiset mihem te hinna din,
Alungset len.
Ahung kumlhai hi leiset’a,
Apengtai leiset naosen’in;
Mihem te jalin gim thoh in,
Alungset len.

2. Chapang ho A anga pomin,
Alungset len,
Aphei chunga pomin vang pen,
Alungset len,
Aching jinge Ama mite,
Agimna dinguva huh in,
Apuitou ding van gam noma,
Alungset len.

3. Thina ding gui sutlham soh in,
Alungset len,
Gam thum aman vaihomin,
Alungset len,
Along athisan tohpa chu,
Ahitai van chunga Thempu;
Ami te thoh bang athoh in,
Alungset len.

4. Van’a nopna a ilut man,
Alungset len,
Lung khat in lhai jingu hite,
Alungset len.
Kai jingu te Christa heng’ah,
Kinemin ami lungsetna;
Sau hite hinlai dam sungin,
Alungset len.

title: SOCHATNA LE HINNA KHOVAH THU
lyrics:
1. Sochatna le hinna khovah thu dong a,
Vaipo khat jan’a Jesu heng a ahung chun,
Jesun thudih tah in ana donbut in,
“Pengthah kit un” ati.

[CHORUS_START]
“Na penthah diu ahi,
Na penthah diu ahi,
Kichen tah a kaseipeh nahi” ati,
Na penthah diu ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesun khuh a kon eihung lhatdoh nau hi,
A thu ngaitouvin mihem chanu chapa ten,
Hiche Thupha hi moh hisah hih hel’un,
Na penthah diu ahi.

3. Nang ho vangam nom’a lutnom ho cheng sen,
Eihuhhing nau Thupha hi kipa lan sauvin,
Tonsot mangmo hinkemlou nanei nom le,
Na penthah diu ahi.

4. Na lung a vangam nom chu namu nom le,
Kotpi hoi phung a chun nang nangah jing uve,
Chuche gamnom hoija chu na lut nom le,
Na penthah diu ahi.

title: O SOPI NANGMAN VANGAM MUCHI
lyrics:
1. O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Jingkah seha nathe jing hinam?
O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu
Janthip gei-a nathe jing hinam ?

[CHORUS_START]
Chang ki-at phat chu ahung naitai,
Chang ki-at chu kichai loi ta ding,
Nangma changpang chu adim na din,
Pon tho tah in tong in nasan ding atam’e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Janthip gei-a nathe jing hinam?
O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Lungtheng sel’a nathe jing hinam?

3. O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Lei phalah a nathe jing hinam?
O Sopi nangman vangam muchi chu,
Miho henga nathe jing

title: PHATTHEI NA GOHONG HUNG JUHEN
lyrics:
1. Phatthei na gohong hung juhen,
Lungsetna eitepna sau,
Juh sah jing jeng hen niseh in,
Jesun hin juh lhah sah in.

[CHORUS_START]
Phatthei na gohong,
Ka ngai ui phatthei na chu,
Mal khou tah in hinjuh sah in,
Hung juhen ka chung-uva.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Go hung jun phatthei na gohong,
Lhagao thisa thoukit hen,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam jol’a,
Hung chin in phatthei na go.

3. Phatthei na gohong hung ju hen,
Pathen hin sollhan tunin,
Ka lung nguisau halsah kit in,
Nei tepnau guilhun sah in.

4. Phat theina gohong hung ju hen,
Juhsah in tuni tah in,
Ka setnau jouse sop theng in,
Jesu ka kou pet chau hin.

title: KAN EIHUNHING LOU DING
lyrics:
1. Kan eihuhhing lou ding,
Kalhin kamai phet jongleh,
Ka lungdon subei lou ding,
Kumsot chonset bei lou ding,
Kan eihuhhing lou ding.

[CHORUS_START]
Kei chuna Jesu thita,
Thingpel’a kikhenbeh ta,
Eingah e huhhing ding in,
Huhhing jou Ama bou.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Toh in eihuh lou ding,
Iti chonphat jeng jong leng,
I tobang in hou jong leng,
Kalung thah sah thei lou ding,
Toh in eihuh lou ding.

3. Ngah leng kei hing lou ding,
Panpi bei mi mangsa kei,
Lungseta eikou pet hin,
Ngah leng keima thita ding,
Ngah leng kei hing lou ding.

4. Christa tahsan hinna,
Pathen Chapa Jesu chun,
A tohchan ken ging cha leng,
A bantha’n eihuhhing ding,
Christa tahsan hinna.

title: KA LEISET HINKHO ABEITENG
lyrics:
1. Ka leiset hinkho abeiteng,
Ken bang ding tulai kalasah,
Pathen inpi sung lim noi-a,
Ka lut teng kei kipah jing ding.

[CHORUS_START]
Kimaito a mu ding, Amai ken,
Lungset na eilhat thu sei ding,
Kimaito a mu ding, Amai ken,
Lungset na eilhat thu sei ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Nikhat ka leiset in chim ding,
Asot apal kasei thei poi,
Ahin ka ding in van chung a,
Mun aum’e ti ken kahei.

3. Nikhat chung toni jong mang ding,
Leiset pahhoi jouse mang ding,
Pakai jin nabol aphai tia,
Eikou teng lut a ol ta ding.

4. Pakai jin kot ahon teng le,
Ka Lhagao lutjel theina din,
Ka thaomei devah jing ing ting,
Kiging in ken ngah jing ing-e.

title: NITIN IN KA TAHSAN’E
lyrics:
1. Nitin in ka tahsan’e,
Ka lung tha alhom teng le,
Ka lam muthim jeng jong le,
Christa a kalung kinem.

[CHORUS_START]
Nitin in katahsan’e,
Lungdong lou ding itih a,
I-tih le kahin laisea,
Christa a kalung kinem.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Kanop kom le la sang e,
Ka gim kom le tao ving e,
Set toh jeng jong leng keima,
Christa a kalung kinem.

3. Pathen Lhagao in keima,
Eisal vah in nitin in,
Aman kei eiching jinge,
Christa a kalung kinem.

4. Keima ka hinlai chan sen,
Hi leiset aman kah sen,
Nopna van gam kalhun man,
Christa a ka lung kinem.

title: NA LUNG HESOH SEL’IN MI’N
lyrics:
1. Na lung hesoh sel’in, mi’n jong anei nai,
Thutah in hasel’in, phate chan sel’in,
Na chang a naumna, lunggel’in ngaiton,
Jesu jah a sei-in, lung mong tante.

2. Jesu jah a sei-in, athohsa ahi,
Seisoh in aheng ah, nang panpi tei ding,
Lungmon theina thu chu, nalung in chingphan,
Pohgih ngaijang anom, ahenga tao in.

3. Lungdong hesoh mihem tamtah aum’e,
Amaho thu gapen lungmonna thu hi,
Sel’in nang lung hesoh, mi chu kipah hen,
Nalung hesoh na chu Jesu heng a lhut jon

title: ADANG CHE NUNG A MOLCHUNG
lyrics:
1. Adang che nung a molchung a,
Kelngoi vahmang keiman,
Hinna lungmon na hong sung lam,
Iti holdoh tang ngem?

[CHORUS_START]
Kei kahi, hinna lam le thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi,
Kei kahi, hinna lam le thutah,
Keima louvin koima Pa kom alhung theipoi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Kana vahmang lengvai jin kei,
Pathen heng jon louvin,
“Hilam khulam’a” eitiuvin,
Thutah la kahol mon.

3. Hinna lam le thutah Jesu,
Henge kachei tukal,
Mangthah kit talou helding in,
A-angah kalut tai.

title: NISA VAH CHE PHAHNA CHAN’A
lyrics:
1. Nisa vah che phahna chan’a,
Gam jousea Jesu vaihom ding,
Gam jouse chung a
Leng chang ding,
Ni le lhavah molmang kahsen.

2. Chitin namtin pao tintang mi’n,
A vahchoi la sanom cheh ding,
Chapang sen san in jong sa ding,
Amin Theng vahchoina la chu.

3. Tan neilouva Ama heng a ,
Taona vahchoina um jing ding,
Amin chu thao namtui bang ding,
Namtin vai jousen housoh ding.

4. Chuteng leiset mi’n ja cheh ding,
A lengpao chu sang soh kei diu,
Vantil jong hung kumlha kit ding,
“Amen” tia lei-jin kho sam ding.

title: HOICHAN GAM HIJONG LE KEI
lyrics:
1. Hoichan gam hijong le kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia, eipuina chan’a chu,
Ama louva lung kipa thanop na bei,
Jesun eilhonpi na a keikicha lou.

[CHORUS_START]
Hoichan a hijong le kei kicha lou ding,
Jesun eilhonpia bit keicha kei che ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Kei ka chang hilou Jesun ei lhonpi nai,
Golle pai thon jong le Ama kanei nai,
Lam hahsa lam’a Aman eipui jong le,
Jesu toh umna chu vah choina in hi.

3. Jesun ei umpina chan’a kei nom’a,
Imu thei kavel iti thim jeng jong le,
Lunglhai sel’a ka jing tho ding chu kahei,
Jesu toh umna chan chu innom ahi.

title: HINKHO TWIPI KINONG HUIPI HAT
lyrics:
1. Hinkho twipi kinong huipi hat natoa,
Mang soh a kingaito-a nalung lhah teng,
Na phattheina jouse aban chan sim in,
Pakai thilbol cheng chu kidang san nate.

[CHORUS_START]
Na phatthei na abanchan sim’in,
Amin son lang abanchan sim’in,
Pakai jin nabol peh chengse chu,
Pakai thilbol cheng chu kidang san nate.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pohgih poa lungkham lung dong a na um em ?
Na put ding a kigot peh Cross chu gih sam ?
Phatthei na sim le chun ginchat lel bei ding,
Sun nisa vah bang in vah jing tan nate.

3. Mi sumnei selnei gamnei navet kom le,
Christan natepsa hao seitheilou ngaiton,
Ahao choh joulou phatthei na chu sim’in,
Tohphat man nasan ding van’a atam’e.

4. Hijeh chun gim genthei iti hah jong le,
Lunglha hih in Pathen achungnung pen’e,
Phattheina sim’in vantil-in nangah nai,
Na lam lhung keija nalhonpi diu ahi.

title: GEISANG LOU JENUN MI CHONSE
lyrics:
1. Geisang lou jenun mi chonse ho,
Christa na hinna diu aume,
Tunin nakouve aw nem tah in,
“Hinna penge” ati.

[CHORUS_START]
Nomhen, nomhen Pakai Christa min,
Kachonset eisop lheng peh pa chu,
Akom’a tonsot’a kachen ding,
Van chung a in theng a.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesun na kouve ngai-in chonsen,
“Hung un chapang ho”hitin ati,
Hung loi un chonse lung lengvaite,
Pakai Christa sang in.

3. Khopho louvin umhih un mite,
Tuni hin Jesun nang na kouve,
Hung un mi chonse lungbei olmo,
Na chonset lung khel’in.

title: LANGEI TAH KHAT KASA NOM’E
lyrics:
1. Langei tah khat kasa nom’e,
Lhatdam kachan apat,
Lhatdampu vahchoi la sang’e,
Lhatdam kachan apat,

[CHORUS_START]
Lhatdam kachan’a pat, (2)
Amin vahchoi jing tang’e,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat,
Amin loupi vahchoi jing tange,
[CHORUS_END]

2. Innom hoitah khat kanei je,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat,
Tonsot in cheng jing ing e kei,
Lhatdam kachan’a pat.

3. Lhandampu vahchoi la sang’e,
Lhatdam ka chan’a pat.
Tonsot in sajing inge ken,
Lhatdam ka chan’a pat.

title: CROSS CHU INJOT NA LAMPIA
lyrics:
1. Cross chu injot na lampia kanei tei ding,
Chulou chu lamdang umlou,
Van kotpi hoi chu keiman mulou ding,
Ka mansah le Cross lampi chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Van in jotna Cross ahi, (2)
Kache pum hin ka lam mu kanom’e,
Van in jotna Cross ahi.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Thisan bena lampi chu kaho tei ding,
Ei-huhhing pa chenna chu,
Van chung innom jon’a kakal tou ding,
Lhagao Pathen toh chen na chu.

3. Vannoi lampi chu kalha doh tai keiman,
A chung ho kit lou hel ding,
Jesun “Hung in” tin ka in ka jon’e,
Kot phung a einga jing na chu.

title: KEIMA INNOM VAN KHOPI KA
lyrics:
1. Keima innom Van khopi ka lhun tengle,
Ka pohgih ho chu akom’a ken ngading,
Kemthei lou Lallukhuh kaki khuh ding ahi,
Ken kipana la a ka vahchoi ding ahi.

[CHORUS_START]
Chung van gam nom keima in chu,
Ka lhun teng le keiman,
Hesoh genthei na ho jouse,
Ken dalha a lung genthei na,
Umlou ding chu mun’a chun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Keima innom van khopi kalhun teng leh,
Leiset muthim jingho umkitta lou ding.
Van gam vah emhoi chun keima eisalvah in,
Van gam kalhun kahsen eisal vah e.

3. Keima innom Van khopi ka lhun teng le,
Ka mit a huhhing pa mel ken mu ta ding,
Pakai Ama vahchun keima eisalvah-in,
Mangthah louva amatoh chengkhom ding.

title: NA LUNG DONSAH HIH HELUN
lyrics:
1. Na lung donsah hih helun,
Pakai-ah lung ngai jun,
Ama jeng a kinem in,
Christa a thi jouse chu,
Van’a ahung pui ding.

[CHORUS_START]
Hijeh chun nang ho,
Khat le khat hi cheng thu hin,
Kilung mon to cheh un,
Hiche jeh chun nang ho,
Hijeh chun nang ho,
Ki lungmon to cheh uvin (2)
Hi cheng chun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Na lungdon sah hih hel’un,
Christa bou tahsan in,
Jan’a lungdon na cheng hi,
Jing a nopsah na ding a,
A man nang hung pui ding.

3. Pakai hung na ding nikho,
Ngah jing in anai tai,
Van’a akalni bang a,
A Mitheng ten hin tom ding,
Hung kilah loi ta ding.

title: NGAIYUN PAKAI DING BOLTE JOUSEN
lyrics:
1. Ngaiyun Pakai ding bolte jousen,
Hatmo leh thi dingin,
Pakai phatthei lhah ngah jing uvin,
Eisem pha jing nante.

[CHORUS_START]
Pakai thahat a kingai chu,
Athau semthah in tin,
Alhan leng tou un tin,
Muvan lai bang in lengtou un tin,
Lhaitou ding u thachol louva,
Chollou-a lamjot diu,
Lhaitou ding u chol lou hel’a ,
Chol louva che diu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Tamtah vei theichim le lung thoi jin,
A chung a iphun’ui,
Huhhing pa hing jing itahsan’ui,
I bol’a kilel dem.

3. Kipah un ei-umpi jing nauve,
Leiset bei ni gei in,
Khodah in hung un lang ma son’un,
I ngai chan eipe ding.

title: NISUN VAH A CHUN CHEN
lyrics:
1. Nisun vah a chun chen nipi vah a chun,
Jing a pahcha pah le janlai dailhah in,
Ni tin’in mason in dettah in pang un,
Lamtin a Jesu jui jin.

[CHORUS_START]
Jui un keiman jong ka jui-e ,
Jui-in ni tin’in jui un,
A man napui le na chan’a
Jui jin Jesu chu a lam tin’ah.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Sun nisat emlai le janlai mu thimin,
Chamkang lou noulai le chuhlai go lon’in,
A man nakou ngai in asei thun nung un,
Lamtin a Jesu jui in.

3. Nisa vah emlai le thimpi jing a jong,
Khopi huinun na le lungdon na a jong,
A mi ngailut gingchan akhon ni gei in,
A nung lhaso lou jen in.

title: JESUN KOT AKIU KIUVE
lyrics:
1. Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Thachol ka heng a hung un,
Ti’n huhhing din nakou ve,
Kot chu hong len in.

[CHORUS_START]
Kot chu hong len in, (2).
Huhhing jou Ama ahi,
Kot chu hong len in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Nang huhnan Ama athin,
Lhan’a kon athoudoh tai,
Kotchu hong len in.

3. Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Don nalung a heng lam’a
Nalung kipana dim ding,
Kot chu hong len in.

4. Jesun kot akiu kiuve,
Huhhing na anai pet hin,
Ajo le chemang kit khante,
Kot chu hong len in.

title: THENNA DING PHAT NEI-JIN NA
lyrics:
1. Thenna ding phat nei-jin na Pathen hou in,
Ama toh um jing in athun kivah in,
Pathen chate ho jong kihou thei pin lang,
A hatmo te hunlang sumil lou jen in.

2. Thenna ding phat nei-in athu nit jing in,
Jesu chu guhthim in atamjon houvin,
Jesu ve jing le chun Ama toh bang ding,
Na gol’in amu din A-um chan bang thon.

3. Thenna ding phat nei jin lam kihil sah in,
A-ang sung ah konin jammang lou jen in,
Gim hesoh na ahi na Pakai jui-in,
Jesu lamkat jing in athu tahsan in.

4. Thenna ding phat nei-in nalung olsah in,
Na lungput jouse chun anoi-a lut in,
A vaihom thun nung in kipuisah jing in,
Ngailut bulpi ahi Van’a puilut thei.

title: HINKHO DEILAI ACHOM’E
lyrics:
1. Hinkho deilai achom’e,
Thingna pullai abang e,
Changphal kansa abang e, kiging un,
Hin nikho akem jing e,
Vangset ni hung lhung inte,
Thina hung lhung loi-in te, kiging un.

[CHORUS_START]
Phat hom’in, kiging un,
Jesun na kou kou laiuhin hin ki gingun,
Setna a umsot leu chun,
Hinna kot hon hom lou-in,
Nalut phat kikhel’inte, kiging un.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pahcha hoilai pulloi in,
Khangdong hoi ache loi-in,
Nang umsot ding nahipoi, kiging un,
Pathen lhan na kou lai hin,
Umhih un ngaisah lou in,
Manna lam’a chun nate, kiging un.

3. Phat akem tultul jing e,
Thi vaihom ahung naije,
Jesu khut a kikhum un, mangang un,
Vangset na ahung lhun’a,
Na Lhagao man masang in,
Aloupina chu sim un, kiging un.

4. Hilna thu chu ngaiphau vin,
Pakai chu tuhdet leu chun,
Van mi jouse kipah ding, kiging un,
Chonset muthim dalhau vin,
Jesu chu tahsan’un lang,
Van lam jon in tun cheuvin, kiging un.

title: SILOAM TWIKUL MOLLIM NOI-A
lyrics:
1. Siloam twikul mollim noi-a,
Pahcha namtui keh chu,
Iti namtui tam molnoi-a,
Saron pah mum hoi chu. (2)

2. Hibang chun tulai khang chapang,
Hoikei chan apeng e,
A lung u thengsel nemheu chan,
Pathen lam asang ui. (2)

3. Siloam twikul mollim noi-a,
Pahcha chu pul tei jin,
Molnoi ya pahcha namtui chu,
Thonmo a molloi jita. (2)

4. Mihem te jong chuto bang ding,
A hinkho alhin teng,
A thi ding lung leng olmo ding,
Thonmo a la thitei ding. (2)

title: BIBLE A THU UM HI
lyrics:
1. Bible a thu um hi Thupha chungnung pen
A thu jouse hinna le sochat na,
Mi thisa jong thoukit ding tin asei-e,
Lhagao mangsa hindoh kit na ahi.

[CHORUS_START]
Bible thu ngai jun, Bible thun nung un,
Mang un Bible Thupha hinna kidang.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ngaiphau vin Bible gou kemlou chungnung thu,
Lhagao hinna le sochatna ahi,
A man jat jong leiset mi’n simthei lou ding,
Hol’in Lhagao phat theina kidang hi.

3. Mi lamvai te ding a Bible meivah pha,
Khangthah dan neilou ding a jong phat na,
Mi chonse ding a hinna le lung olna,
Teh le khang dinga hibou Thupha pen.

title: O NGEI TAH IN SAKIT
lyrics:
1. O ngei tah in sakit tem in,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Hi thu chu kei neihil beuvin,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Hiche Pathen thu hin,
Phat na thu eihil’e.

[CHORUS_START]
(Thungei chungnung thu kidang tah
Hinna le nopna thu.) x 2
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesun mi jouse ahom’e,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Ngai-jin nalung hongun sang un,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Manbei jin ahom’e,
Vanna lutthei na din.

3. Hibang hinna Thupha kidang,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Kajah man kei ka lung mong e,
Hinna le nopna thu,
Jesu bou mi huhhing,
Lungmon konna ahi.

title: SEI-IN THUSIM LUI THU CHU
lyrics:
1. Sei-in thusim lui thu chu,
Mulou Van chung gam thu,
Pakai Jesu Loupi le
Ami lungset thu chan,
Sei-in thusim chu olchan,
Chapang kihil bang chun,
Keima mi chonse le lung,
Neilou olmo ngai din.

[CHORUS_START]
Sei-in thusim lui thu (3)
Jesu mi lungset thu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Sei-in thusim lui thu chu,
Ka chin jing thei na din,
Mihem te chonset jal’a,
Jesu lei-a pen thu,
Sei-in hichu niseh in,
Thupha kidang ahi,
Lungdon le olmo kom a,
Ka lung monna ahi.

3. Sei-in thusim lui thu chu,
Lungdon olmo kom le,
Hi leiset gou homkeu,
Nop le ol jong chutia ,
Hi leiset ka dalhah a,
Van gam nom ka lhun man,
Sei-in thusim lui thu chu,
Jesu mi huhhing thu.

title: VANNOI GAMTIN CHONSET MUTHIM IN
lyrics:
1. Vannoi gamtin chonset muthim in aloi,
Hinna thun salvah un,
Lhagao huhhing a um nom’a atam’e,
Hinna thun salvah un.

[CHORUS_START]
Sochat na hinna Thupha vahchun,
A gamtin salvah soh hen,
Sochat na hinna Thupha vahchun,
Tonsot gei in salvah hen.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jet le vei-a igam miten eikou-ui,
Hinna thun salvah un,
Kipah tah le thanom tah in choileu te,
Hinna thun salvah un.

3. Hinna Thupha mijousen amu thei nan,
Hinna thun salvah un,
Hinna Thuphan gamtin alosoh na ding,
Hinna thun salvah un.

4. Hinna thu lhacha ipan hi chimpoute,
Hinna thun salvah un,
Van’a ivondiu thilpha khol ihiuve,
Hinna thun salvah un.

title: HUNG UN PATHEN NGAITE
lyrics:
1. Hung un Pathen ngaite,
Kipah in la sauvin,
Kipah in la sacheh un lang (2)
Kikhom un kimvel’un. (2)

[CHORUS_START]
Cheu hite Zion ah,
Zion gam nom chungnung em’a;
Cheu hite Zion gam nom’a,
Pathen khopi nom tah a chun.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pathen hepha lou ten,
Vahchoi da jeng jong leu,
Eiho Pathen Chate sen vang (2)
Phong un na lung kipau. (2)

3. Pathen ki houna a,
A sangjan thanom un,
Van’a khopi hoi ilhun man (2)
I len man lam em’a. (2).

4. Chu a lhi kang soh ding,
Kipa la isah diu,
Immanual cha ihiuve (2)
Van khopi-a ilen diu. (2)

title: KA DINGE DETTAH IN GALVON
lyrics:
1. Ka dinge dettah in galvon po kahi,
Ka ngah jinge Lengpan thu eipeh ding,
Malam nonge Leng in thu eipeh leh,
Akom’a dinging ting Ama jen lenge.

[CHORUS_START]
‘‘Ngaijun malam nouvin” tia galsam khu,
Anu nungui ven mi kichase ho,
Pakai jin keima einganse tei ding,
Agalvon choi bou kahi jeng vang in,
Pakai in keima einganse tei ding,
Agalvon choi bou kahi jeng vang in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ka ding jinge dettah in galvon choi-in,
Phasa dem in chem le thal lum kathoi,
Gal kisat gin ngah in ka ding e kei,
“Pakai ka ding nai” kati theina ding in.

3. Von po bou hi jong leng chan kanei tei ding,
Loupina kemlou le Lallukhuh hoi,
Tahsan nei-a gal kisat jouse a chu,
Pathen ang a maipha chang tei ding keima.

title: NGAI-UN PAKAI JESUN EIKOU
lyrics:
1. Ngai-un Pakai Jesun eikou,
Tunia vaikon ding koiham?
Jao a angtai, chang amintai,
Aga chom khom ding hoiham?
“Acha’ng at chu manpha penge”
Hitin ati Pakai in,
Keima kaum nai neisol’in,
Lhaisel a ti ding hoiham?

2. Khol gamla che hih jong leu chun,
Holdoh ding amangsa te,
Mu’nnate thilha hou sangja,
Hiho chu hinna thu pen,
Sum tampi ahilou vang in,
Paini jeng cha hi jong le,
Hiche themcha jong chu Jesun,
Tamtah in sang tei nante.

3. Thusei jin themhih jong leu chun,
Solchah Paul seithem bang in,
Jesu milungset seileu-vin,
Ei jal’a athi jeh chun,
Thupi tan ding kicha louva,
Mi chonse ho a dau le,
Chapang ho hin kou khom leu chun,
Pathen in kipom nante.

4. Pakai aw-gin najah mau le,
Mihem hinkho kemlai hin,
Na thaset man in tidau vin,
“Keima ka-i aloupoi”
Lunglhai sel in Pathen na tong un,
Tong jing un thanom tah in,
Asei najah mau le tiuvin,
“Pathen keima neisol in”.

title: KOI HIJONG LE THUPHA HI
lyrics:
1. Koi hijong le Thupha hi ajachan in,
Kipana thu hi leiset gam kimvel a,
Phong un homjal un mi umna mun jousea,
“Ahung nomchan hung u hen”.

[CHORUS_START]
Koi hijeng jong le ahung nom chan chu,
Thinglhang le phaicham dam’a gasam leuvin,
Pan vahmang ho inlam’a akouna hi,
“Ahung nom chan hung u hen”.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ahung nom chan chu hung geisang lou jenun;
Kot kihon lutthei petcha hin lut loi-un,
Jesu chu hinna lampi dihtah ahi.
“Ahung nom chan hung uhen”.

3. Ahungnom chan chu thu tepsa aum’e,
Ahung nom chan chu um jing jeng ding ahi,
Koi hile anom chan hing jing ding ahi,
“Ahung nom chan hung u hen”.

title: THOUVIN KALUNG NISA SOH TOH
lyrics:
1. Thouvin kalung nisa soh toh kijui-in,
Kalung in Pathen jeng gel’in,
Lunglhai selle lunghal pel’in lhai ponthon,
Mei-in konghen Pathen Nang ngai.

2. Sun le jan neilou Van Mitheng te jousen,
Pathen thusim asim jingui,
Nangman jong amaho lasah jeng gel’in
Navah choi na la sangin san.

3. Pathen tujan kalha nahoi damsel’a,
Hinkho thah neipeh tujing a,
Hibang chun Van gamnom’a khovah jing le,
Neilan nangma gam nom sung a.

4. Neiching jingin chonphat le lungnem neipen,
Na-Lhagao Theng chun neipui len,
Tunia kachonnau katoh kasei jouseu,
Pathen mitmua lamjang dingin.

title: DANIEL LOI BANGIN DINGUN PATHEN
lyrics:
1. Daniel loi bangin dingun Pathen thun nungun,
Pahchaute loi lhom ho chun Daniel loi vahchoi-un;

[CHORUS_START]
Daniel bangin hangun,
Na changin dingin,
Na hannau chu leiset mi’n,
Heu hen pang det un.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Mihet minthanga kisei vannoi chonsoh ho,
Pathen lama dia pang mihat sangja mangsoh ta.

3. Gospel ponlap dom sungun Gal jo na dingin,
Satan gal chu no mangun Daniel dingin aovun.

title: DAM DUNG LHUNG A JESU
lyrics:
1. Dam dung lhung a Jesu nung jui ding ka nom’e,
Pahcha namtui pah na le twilhum lon na a,
Hoichan hi jongle eipuina chan’a jui-inge,
Anung jui inge Lallukhuh kasan man.

[CHORUS_START]
Juiding, juiding, Jesu nung kajui ding,
Achena chan’a anung nung kajui ding,
Juiding, juiding, Jesu nung kajui ding,
Aman eipuina chan’a ken kajui ding.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Dam dung lhung a keiman Jesu nung kajui ding,
Khopi hui nunna le twilhum lonna a chun
Ama khut in eipui le keima kicha lou ding,
Aman eilhon pi le keima olmo lou ding.

3. Dam dung hihen lang mol-a kalding hijong leng,
Ka Lhagao Jesu kom a chu umjing jeng hen,
Bitkei le damsel chan Aman eipui lhung kei ding,
Ol eipeh na ding Pathen inpi nom chu.

title: VAN’A PONLAP KHU HUNG VEUVIN
lyrics:
1. Van’a ponlap khu hung veuvin hung un sopi te,
Galmi thah sangja ahunge, gal ijotei diu.

[CHORUS_START]
Kul dalha hih un ka hung e,
Tin Jesun asam,
Nang thahat vang in lhapong e,
Neipen Leng pan tha.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Veuvin asangja ahung e, Satan sepai te,
Eima sepai te kichat in alungthoi gamtai.

3. Galjona ponlap khu veuvin, ngaijun sumkon gin,
Pakai min a ijo tei diu, gal te tam jong le.

4. Gal kisat a hahsat vang in eipanpi tamna,
Igal lamkai hattah Jesu, iham igin diu.

title: NATONG IN KON UTE EIHO
lyrics:
1. Natong in kon ute eiho Pathen sohte,
I-Pakai nung jui-in cheu hite na tong in,
A man eipeh lungthim thah chu pan uhite,
I-khut’a itoh thei chan tong cheh uhite.

[CHORUS_START]
Tong ute ............ hatah in,
Na tong un...........pontah in,
Ngah ute ............ kinemin,
Bang pou te Pakai hung kahsen.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Na tong cheh uhite, agilkel vana ding,
Lhagao dang chah ho dang nou na din peu hite,
I-loupina dingun Cross thu seileu hite,
“Manbei jin eihuhhing ui” tin sam leu hite.

3. I-bonchan cheu hitin na ga tong uhite,
Chonset muthim gam chu apumpin mangsoh hen,
Jehovah Mintheng loupi chu kilang soh hen,
“Manbei jin eihuhhing ui” tin sam leu hite.

4. Pontho tah in pang un, Pakai thahat pan un,
Tohphat man isan diu Pathen in eipeh diu,
Lhatsa Mithengte toh van’a ichen khom diu,
“Manbei jin eihhuhing ui” tin sam leu hite.

title: MIHEM CHENNA CHAN’A GALHANG SAM
lyrics:
1. Mihem chenna chan’a, galhang sam leu hite,
Hung un Christa mite, seileu te limtah in,
Mi chonse te heng a, lungmona Thupha hi,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

[CHORUS_START]
Lhamon sah ahung tai, (2)
Pathen in eipeh u,
Eitepnau Lhagao Theng,
Mihem chenna chan’a,
Ga lhang sam leu hite,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Muthim lungdon lengvai, gim le hesoh genthei,
Abonchan achai jin, gamtin asal sohtai,
Inhoi lultah bang in, Nisa so em bang in,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

3. Leng jouse Leng chungnung, mi damsah Lhagao-in,
Mi chonse te heng a, hinna thu hinpo lhan,
Hung un huhhing sate, langei hi sau hite,
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

4. Lungsetna chungnung thu, lan sa choi leu hite,
Van chung a cheng ho toh, kitoh in sau hite,
La ngei hi bang louvin, sau hite limtah in.
Lhamon sah ahung tai.

title: NAIJA GAMLA CHANG AMINTAI
lyrics:
1. Naija gamla chang amintai,
Changvui akoisop gamtai,
Naija gamla a-angsoh tai,
Den’a lep a phaicham’a.

[CHORUS_START]
Pakai chang at ding hinsol’in,
Na heng a ka taonau hi,
Ngaijin chang at ding hinsol in,
Chang at kile get inte.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jingpi nison hinsol loiyin,
Sun nisat in hin sol in,
Nilhum kon gei jin hinsol in,
Gamtin chang at khom ding in.

3. Man gang un chang akoijou tai,
Changvui min at khom loi-un,
Nilhah teng le inlam jon’a,
Kipah a che ding nahi.

title: MAN GANGUN MAN GANGUN KHOVAH
lyrics:
1. Man gangun, man gangun khovah thu seiphong len
Jan muthim gama cheng miho khu gahil un ;
Pakai thupeh ahi, ama minin konun,
Gospel thu kidang tah Jesu milungsetna,
Nahin nau mang cha in sunlaiyin na tongun,
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.

2. Man gangun, man ganggun hinna thu gahomun,
Pakai awgin hepha lou ho khu ga hil un ;
Jing lhavingin lengleuvin Twikhanglen chunga,
Pakai thahat panin amangsa huh doh un;
Nakou kit leu-ui chomkhat jong geisang hih un
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.

3. Man gangun, Thupha chu po-in lhangsam loiyun,
Lhep nan bul’a ahen ganthei lhagao ho khu;
“Lhadoh tei ding” tia Pakai in thu atepsa,
Golvah ankong akithuh tai kou khom loi-un,
Geisang louvin khom un aphat aum tapoi,
Man gangun, man gangun, man gangun.

title: MUN A-ONG NALAIYE KOU KHOM
lyrics:
1. Mun a-ong nalaiye kou khom un,
Lengpa golvah ankong umdin,
Kou khom uvin lang a in mi dim hen,
Mi vaicha gilkel ten neu hen.

[CHORUS_START]
Lamlen’a le daipam’a pot un,
Setna lam thim’a umte chu,
Chen lang ngailut le lungset thon lang,
Vahvei ho gapui khom un.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Mun a-ong nalaiye khom kit un,
Amavang eingai sah lou le,
Kouna O ngai louva kilepmang ho chu,
Koiman kou kit talou helding.

3. Mun a-ong na laiye kou khom un,
Chung’a Pathen thupeh ahi,
Lungsetna hong sung a gapui khom unlang,
Huhhing pa lungset na a chun.

4. Genthei lengvai le ahao din jong,
Van ah mun a-ong na laiye,
Koukhom loi-uvin kot kihon pet cha in,
Gunchun hilchen kimvel leuvin.

title: O PATHEN SALVAH SOH LOIYIN
lyrics:
1. O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Vannoi leiset salvah in,
A lhatpau deitah min’a chu,
A sochat theina diuvin.

[CHORUS_START]
O Pathen salvah soh loiyin,
Twikhanglen gal’a mite,
Lungset na Thupha manbei-a,
Hom ding a natep sa chu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Lhagao thikon ho salvah in,
Jan muthim’a lamvai te,
A hin nikhou alhin kah in,
Salvah in huhhing loiyin.

3. Athutep theng le loupi chu,
“Cheuvin leiset gamtin ah
A khon ni gei-in ka umpi,
Ka Thupha phongjal leuvin”.

title: PAKAI THAHAT PAN IN HAT
lyrics:
1. Pakai thahat pan in hat un athu gingchan,
A Thupha theng phongun lhangsam leuvin,
Galsat lungdon na a jong Aman eikai hoi jing ding,
Pakai min a koiham eidou thei diu.

[CHORUS_START]
Dingdet un, thudih a,
Leng thupeh ngai jun galjo na ding,
Pakai choi-at na dingin, athutep molso din,
Pakai thahat pan in ding det un.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pakai thahat pan un hat un athu gingchan,
Gal masang a kon nung jam kit lou ding,
Ama na kom’a ding jing ding na galsat huding in,
Malam nouvin athahat chu pan un.

3. Pakai thahat pan un hat un a thu gingchan,
I-tih chan’a athutep thon ngai lou,
Aman na khut jetlam atuh jing e kicha hih in,
Pakai chu tahsan jing in ding det in.

title: NGAIYUN PAKAI IN EIKOU-UI TUN
lyrics:
1. Ngaiyun Pakai in eikou-ui tun,
Leiset ga chom khom din,
Chang-at khom ding mi alhom jeh in,
Changvui akoi joutai.

[CHORUS_START]
Pakai min in kipah in cheuvin,
Ngailut le khoto thon,
Manbei ja huhhing a nunnom chu,
Vannoi-ah phong leuvin.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Cheuvin amang ding kon huhdoh un,
Chonset muthim’a kon,
Aban thahat pan un huhhing un,
Chonset bulpu galhan.

3. Kipah tah in genthei kou khom un,
Lungset ankong um din,
Amaho chu hinna changlhah a,
Pakai in lamto ding.

4. Cheleuvin nipi lai akem’e,
Nilhum man tong loi-un,
Koiman na atoh thei louna ding,
Jan muthim anaitai.

title: LUNGHEL LUNGDONG LHAMONUTE
lyrics:
1. Lunghel lungdong lhamonute,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Lhagao mang ding ho huh ute,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Ama ho kipana ding,
Tong ute hinlai sung in,
Thilpha bolthei cheh ihi,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin.

[CHORUS_START]
Akem’e .........hin nikho (2)
Thilpha bolthei cheh ihi,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Mi thase ding a phat umlou,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Namai jing ninou soh bang hen,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Vannoi leiset khoisat dim,
Ka le lhiso na a dim,
U-le nao lhu phong ding in,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin.

3. Ki lungset nan eikan khom-ui,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Khat cheng in iki dalhauve,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin,
Hijong le ithilpha bol,
Vannoi hetna kilang ding,
Hichun ilung u nem ding,
Hin nikho kemlai sung hin.

title: LENG SEPAI IHIUVE THISAN’A KILHAT
lyrics:
1. Leng sepai ihiuve, Thisan’a kilhat sa,
Min khumsa galsat pi ding a,
Pakai Christa Leng chu, kichat aum vang in,
Kipah in la saute,
Leng sepai lamkai chungnung chun,
I-lung hatsah jing ding.

[CHORUS_START]
Leng sepai ihiuve,
A vahchoi la saute,
Tahsan nei jing na ding bol un,
I-Lengpau loupi chu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Leng sepai ihiuve, kipah in choi leuvin,
Cross chung a kithat pa min ngei,
A chung a kisun chu, Leng sepai ihiuve,
Hahkam jeng jong leuhen,
Leng chungnung Jesu choi-at nan,
Hesoh na jong thoh un.

3. Leng sepai ihiuve, Ama toh pangkhom chu,
Tun Ama toh thohkhom hen lang,
Pampai hijong leu hen, Aponlap domsang un,
Phat lhin ding kon ahi,
Lallukhuh san ni anaije,
Leng sepai te ding in.

title: KHUT GOH KEOVA KACHE DING
lyrics:
1. Khut goh keova kache ding ham?
Eilhatpa lamto ding a,
Ana nikhat jong tong louva,
Ima lan ding neilou-a.

[CHORUS_START]
Kache ding ham khutgoh keuva?
Eihuhhing pa lamto-a chu,
Lhagao khat beh keng lou hel a,
Kache ding ham khut goh a?
[CHORUS_END]

2. Thina in eikai lut lou ding,
Tua Jesun eihuhhing ta,
Ka lamto ding bou khut goh a,
Phamo san kalung kham’e.

3. Ka sumang tai kum pha lai cheng,
Kou la ka kou kit thei pon,
Hichu ajen nan mang ta leng,
A lunggot molso ta ding.

4. Thina jan chun hinpha le chun,
Lhagao khat huhhing lou vin,
Na huhhing pa loupi tah chu,
I-pin lamto tan na tem?

title: NA TONG UN JAN ANAITAI
lyrics:
1. Na tong un jan anaitai,
Na tong un jing kah in,
Na tong un daitwi hulman,
Pahcha pah lai-in,
Na tongun nisa jong leh,
Tong un nilhah dai in,
Mite natoh chaiphat jan,
Hung lhung ding ahi.

2. Tong un jan ahung naiye,
Tong un sun nisat in,
Tong un nidan phat laiyin,
Ol-na anaitai,
Tong un mitphet kah cha jong,
Ol gota-di louvin,
Tong un jan anaitai, mi’n
Tong kit ta lou ding.

3. Tong un jan ahung naitai,
Tong un nilhang kai in,
Tong un ni alhum gei in,
Tantih neilou in,
Khovah laisen na tong un,
Namu thei lai chan sen,
Tong un athim tul tul’e,
Ol-na anai tai.

title: HINNA GUI JAN LHAN THI
lyrics:
1. Hinna gui jan lhan thi ding mi aum.
Chonset twikhanglen nong laiya umte,
Koiham twinong lai pal’a mi huhding,
Hinna gui janlhan mi gahuhdoh loiyin.

[CHORUS_START]
Hinna gui janlhan, (2)
Twi-a mi mang ding ahi.
Hinna gui janlhan (2)
Twi-a mi alhalut e.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Hinna gui janlhan natha le lung thon,
Ngaiyin lhagao mang din nang na kouve,
Vetan chonse twilen’a thi ding mi,
Hinna kong khailhan mi mang ding huhhing in.

3. Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding ngaiton,
Chonset twipin chup le hom jou lou ding,
Huipi gopi kithon hinpha ta leu,
Mangtei diu chen nangman ga huhdoh loiyin.

4. Mi mang ding lahphat kikhel loi ta ding,
Lhagao tamtah aman ding tonsot a,
Geisang lou vin chen hinna kong keng in,
Hinna gui janlhan mi mang ding huhdoh in.

title: PATHEN LEKHA SIM JING A
lyrics:
1. Pathen lekha sim jing a,
A sun ajan a ngaito a,
A gunchu a thanom pan,
Pathen phat thei peh amui.

[CHORUS_START]
Hijeh chun sun le jan in,
Lung ngai nan nei jing un lang,
A thulu ching jing jeng in,
Phatthei na hinkem louna.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Mi chonse houlim pi lou,
Mi gilou nung juilou-a,
Mi seise te kom dalha,
Michun chonset apailhai.

3. Luipang a thingphung keh chu,
A na’n goptih nei talou,
Hiche thing hin thei bang chun,
Mitheng nop jong kemthei lou.

4. Chonse vang chuto bang lou,
Hui-ja vai kithe bang ding,
Pathen thupi tan nileh,
Mi chonse chu pampai ding.

title: TOHGIM LE LUNG JINNA KHEL
lyrics:
1. Tohgim le lung jinna khel a,
Cholte din in nom tah aum,
Kikhel tih neilou innom a,
Koiham cholnga nom lou ding chu?

[CHORUS_START]
Ngah hat in lung neng in phunlou in (2),
Ngah hat in lung neng tah in, Phun lou in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Pohgih noiya chol jong le chun,
Van phat na in nang ngai jang ding,
Dah in ven tonsot anai tai,
Ngah in phunlou vin ngah hat in.

3. Na lampia ling um jeng jong le,
Pakai lu kimvel ngaiton lang,
Na lung sudong ta jeng jong le,
Nang sang a thengjon asuntai.

4. Na jong le chun tong jing tang-em,
Taona ima sumil lou in,
Na olna ding ni anaitai,
Ngah hat in phun lou-in ngah in.

title: CHEN LANG NAPHAT JOUSEN TONG
lyrics:
1. Chen lang naphat jousen tong in,
Kipa nan Pa deilam bol’in,
Hichu Pakai lampi ahi,
Najot lou ding ham ajui-an. (2)

2. Hinkho hoilaiyin chen tong in,
Seiset japina ging louvin,
Mihem in a pachat lou chu,
Pathen pachat lou-in geldan. (2)

3. Chen lang tong in tohphat ahi,
Nalung sung kipasah in lang,
Pakai jin na pachat ding chu,
Gel in thanom in na tong in. (2)

4. Tong jing in chim louvin tong in,
Lhagao mang dingin lei aloi,
Vannoi gamtin’a vahlen lang,
Lhagao mang te chu puikhom in. (2)

5. Kipah in natoh kipa pin,
Tohgim chu olna nom ahi,
Ngai-un jaloi ding Pakai O,
“Kahunge” ti O chu ngaiphan. (2)

title: ANITIN PATHEN CHATE BANG A
lyrics:
1. Anitin Pathen chate bang a vah a icheu hinam?
Jan muthim natoh pailha kho hungvah ding ingau hinam?
Lei lungngai jouse dalha kho hung vah ding chu ngah jingin,
Lhandampu lungset jal a hung soh ding ninou emsel chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Amit mua ......icheu hinam?
Pathen cha .....deite bang a,
Christa thisan lua chu ivon u Isop bang u hinam?
Loupina chang ding khovah chate bang a icheu hinam?
[CHORUS_END]

2. Nunnem’a Pathen chate bang a vah a icheu hinam?
Hi leiset lungdon hesoh genthei muthim jing noi-a hi,
Pakai-in Ama khel’a tong ding in eidei cheh-uve,
Tonsot hinkem lou chang ding in mi kholkhom loi-uhite.

3. Vahchoi la saute kipah tah in khovah chate bangin,
Lhaisel’in Christa ding in mite laha na tong ute,
Chutile leiset miten sochatna thu hinjom cheh diu,
Chu-a kon Pathen khopi jon’a Christa i-juikhom diu.

title: CALVARY KA NGAIYE CALVARY LUNGSETNA
lyrics:
1. Calvary ka ngaiye, Calvary lungsetna
Pakai Cross noiah kei katouve,
Cross noiya lung ol tantih neilou
Nop le olna sochat na ahi.

2. Chonset muthim noiyah genthei tah-in athi,
Kagah ven ken katija sa san,
Pathen Kelngoi nou kithat ahi,
Kei jal’a Jesu kithat ahi.

3. Ka miltai lei lungngai lim oldam ka changtai,
Hibang lungsetna vannoi-a bei,
Cross noi-a kachen kei kalung mong,
Calvarya michonse asohchai.

4. Lungset in ka hoitai thisana hing ka hi,
Pathen kom a mun nom ka chang tai,
Iti eikilung set a hitam !
Lungset chungnung chonse kei chunga.

title: DINGUN DINGUN JESU DIN
lyrics:
1. Dingun, dingun, Jesu din,
Nang ho Cross sepai te,
A Leng ponlap domsang un,
Manglou hel ding ahi,
Galjou akon galjou ding,
A sepai te pui ding,
Gal jouse abeisoh a,
Christa Leng chan kahsen.

2. Dingun, dingun, Jesu din,
Sumkon gin thun chon-un,
Gim genthei hahsa thoh un,
A niloupi lai hin,
Tua ading bol a nangho,
Gal simsen lou sat cheng,
Lung ngam’un settona jong,
Thahatna sumang un.

3. Dingun, dingun, Jesu din,
Ama thahat pan un,
Tahsa khut thahat thonthei,
Nangma tha sondauvin,
Gospel galvon kivon un,
Kiging phan tao jing un,
Toh ding in na kou nauva,
Lhah chomna nei hih un.

4. Dingun, dingun, Jesu din,
Galsat sotta lou ding,
Tunia gal kisat kisei,
Jing le jo la sah ding,
A ding a doujou pa chu,
Hinna lukhuh chang ding,
Loupina Leng chungnung toh,
Tonsot vaihom khom ding.

title: CHRISTIAN THOUVIN IMUT SOTDAN
lyrics:
1. Christian thouvin ihmut sotdan,
Lhagao mang ding don lou-in,
Pakai-in thu eipeh lai a,
I-moh toumai mai diu ham?

[CHORUS_START]
Chen lang tong in tun pan in,
Amangsa holdoh kit din,
Chonset muthim a kon in,
Golvah na a hinpui in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Huhhing pa ingailut nah um ?
Athupeh initnah um ?
I-nei jouse iphalnah um ?
Athua inun lou ding ham ?

3. Ama chu itahsan nah um ?
Ahil a ichon nah um ?
Eiho Ama a ihiuvem,
Na natoh in phong cheh un.

4. Lallukhuh san itup u leh,
Cross nitin in pu’hite,
Gunchu tah in na tong ute,
Phat achom ni anai tai.

title: KALHAN VAN LENGPA VAHCHOI-IN
lyrics:
1. Kalhan Van Lengpa vahchoi-in,
Bohkhup in akho muh a,
Nahin sah nadam sah Pathen,
Na ngaidam e vahchoi-in.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Vahchoi-un Tonsot Leng chu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Lung donna Pi le Pu te,
Ana khoto a vahchoi-un,
Abang hi-jing chu vahchoi-un,
Phatthei na eipe a chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Pa-Pathen chu vahchoi-un.
[CHORUS_END]

3. Nu le Pan cha alungset bang,
Eiho hatmo je ahen,
Akhut in eina pom leuve,
Gal a kon eihuhhing-ui.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahchoi cheh un (2)
Lungset henlang vahchoi-un.
[CHORUS_END]

4. Vantil neihun a vahchoi nan,
Mujing nahi Amaiso,
Nisa lha sa le namtin mi,
A kuncheh e A-ang ah.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahchoi cheh un, (2)
Mi khoto Pathen Theng chu.
[CHORUS_END]

title: TUNIN KUMLUI ABEISOH TAI
lyrics:
1. Tunin kumlui abeisoh tai,
Kumthah ahung lhung tai,
Tao u hite Pathen heng a,
I chonset beina din. (2)

2. Kumlui hitia chemang bang hin,
Akem’e ihinkho,
Akem jing e aniseh in,
Akem mangloi jitai. (2)

3. Hijeh chun Sopi te hungun,
Pathen nai-u hite,
Amajeng a chu kinem in,
Tonsot hin jing na din. (2)

4. Hiche kumthah hung lhun bang in,
Thah hen i-lung u jong,
Aga phat apunthei na din,
Kiha boluhite. (2)

5. Vo Pathen, Nang ka tahsanna,
Khanghen aniseh in,
Ka kinepnau hin khan sah in,
Det hen thihhat aiyin. (2)

title: VAN MITHENG TE JOUSEN KIPA
lyrics:
1. Van Mitheng te jousen kipa la sauvin,
Tunin mi mangsa khat ahung e,
Veovin! lung kipah tah in Pathen achei,
Acha A-ang a kipom ding in.

[CHORUS_START]
Kipa thanop loupi ni nopni,
“Loupi ni” atiuve Vantil ten,
Van Mitheng te jouse akikhom-uvin,
La asauve lung kipah tah in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Van’a nop la sauvin Van Mitheng jousen,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in,
Aman ahin dalhan chonset lampi chu,
Ahungtai Apa Pathen heng ah.

3. Lei-a nop la sauvin Mitheng te jousen,
Mi jouse hom’un hinna Thupha,
I-mitlhiu jong long hen ikipa man’un,
Tunia chonse khat sochat jal’in.

title: LUNGSET NA NAMU HITAM BAN
lyrics:
1. Lungset na namu hitam, ban tol in,
Nang chang ding jeng ahipoi, ban tol in,
Va le sah in kumlhung in,
Midang mitlhi theh sah-in,
Nabol van’a kiphon man, ban tol in.

2. Ngailut na thu najatan, ban tol in,
Vacha te lasah bang in, ban tol in,
Ala hi khan tousah in,
Mi lengvai kipa sah in,
Mi tusa na at ahi, ban tol in.

3. Jesu mi lungset na hi, bantol in,
Chomkhat bou um ding ihiu, ban tol in,
Tunpi pahcha hoi lai in,
Vachate lasah lai in, Khokhal lai le noplai hin, bantol in.

4. Nang chang ding jeng gel hih in, ban tol in,
Na sopin angai chu hin, ban tol in,
Nangma chang hin moh ahi,
Christa ding in hingle chun,
Ama toh nachen khom ding, ban tol in.

title: TWIKHANGLEN PANG A INVAH KISONG
lyrics:
1. Twikhanglen pang a invah kisong bang in,
Vah in muthim lah a chonse te mudin,
Nalung kot hong in kithopi hung nate.

[CHORUS_START]
Vahsah in Pathen thu chu (3).
Na thaomei a vah lai hin kitheh ngim in,
Vahsah in Pathen thu chu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Kong sesa bang in mi tamtah aumtai,
Muntin’a mihem set thim noi ah aum,
Hilleuvin settona muntin’a umho.

3. Navah emhoi chu lo khukhum lou jen un,
Navah chu mite muthei din koisang in,
Salvah in jan muthim phat thei nang chan ding,

4. Na hinkho beikah in Christa din tong in,
Christan nangma “Hung in” tia na kou teng le,
Hiche leiset mun hi jot kit ponna te.

title: JESUN EISOL-UI VAH HOM LE
lyrics:
1. Jesun eisol-ui vah hom le dingin,
Jan muthim’a meivah cha bang in vah in,
Hi leiset muthim hi salvah din,
Nangma muna nangman kei muna ken.

2. Jesun eisol-ui ading a vahdin,
I-vah u amolteng le Aman ahei,
Van’a kon in eihin ve jingui,
Nangma muna nangman, kei muna ken.

3. Jesun eisol-ui midang salvah din,
Muthim’in akhui vannoi leiset mite,
A chonset hesoh nau sumang din,
Nangma muna nangma kei muna ken.

title: PAKAI VAHCHOI NAN KEN LAN
lyrics:
1. Pakai vahchoi nan ken lan sang e,
Kakam le kalung tho’ng ting,
Eingailut kidang chu vahchoi nan,
Sang e a vahchoi la.

[CHORUS_START]
Ka chonset jouse apo mang tai,
Amin Theng Loupi vahchoi la sang e,
Ka chonset jouse apomang tai,
Hallelujah Amin in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Ka hung e ka chonset poh pum in,
Aman olna kim eipei,
Eilhat doh jeh chun a vahchoi la,
Tanglou vin ken sang e.

3. Aheng kalhun teng kei bit kei-a,
Aman eihon bit kei-a,
Ken hasah cheh ding a vahchoi la,
Tonsot gei a sa ding.

title: I-KIMUTO KIT DIN EINEM’E
lyrics:
1. I-kimuto kit din einem’e,
Leiset hinkho abeiteng,
Thusim lui sei ding chu einem’e,
Vangam nom vah jing a chun.

[CHORUS_START]
Gamnom vah a chun (2)
I-Pau chenna gam innom tah a chun,
Kimuto nau hite kimuto nau hite,
Galjo na Lallukhuh isan diu.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Loupia kimu to din einem’e.
Hinna thingphung hoi lim a,
Eilhatpau vahchoi din einem’e,
A lungsetna eilhat chu.

3. Loupia kimuto din einem’e,
Chung Alaltouna kim a ,
Lhatsa janel a vahchoi la sa,
Mitheng lah a lhah ding chu.

4. Loupia kimuto din einem’e,
Leiset kin kachai tengle,
Kipah tah a ikikhut tuhdiu,
Tonsot gamnom em a chun.

title: KASOPI TEN NEILHA TAOVIN
lyrics:
1. Kasopi ten neilha taovin,
Ka van in jon in chetang e,
Vannoi leiset a umlai-a,
Ka nga jing van innom chu.

[CHORUS_START]
Ka van innom, ka van innom,
Tonsot a hinna nop kem kit louna,
Neisol tauvin lung lhaisel in,
Neilha tauvin Sopi ten.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Van gam kal masa Jesu chun,
Ka umna ding mun asem’e,
Tun eikouve chua cheng din,
Kipah tah in chetang e.

3. Chonset dim vannoi a hin,
Gim hesoh kachaitai tun,
Ka Pathen in sem ah cheng ting,
Nop kemlou ah cheng tang e.

4. Lunghel lou jenun sopi te,
Leiah kimu hih jong leu;
Ni khat van in noma thon moa,
Ikimu to kittei diu.

title: O HE TUNI LEISET BEI
lyrics:
1. O he tuni leiset bei ni,
A bang e ikikhen hi,
Pathen in phat theina chamkim,
Penlang damsel’in chetan.

[CHORUS_START]
I-kikhen ahitai, Tunin,
Na chena chan’a damsel chan chen,
Pathen in kivoppi jing tan,
Lei chibai chaina sang in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Tunin Nangma heng lam jon in,
A hung e na Kelngoi nou,
Pathen in kichin jing in lang,
A van gam’a puilut in.

3. Pathen thahat nan damsel chan,
Chetan lungset ngai chullou,
Pakai Jesu Christ’n lhonpin,
Van gam nom lai-a leng ding.

4. Pakai chen na Van gam nom’a
Kimuto ding kinem in,
I-kimuto kahsen Pathen ,
Jeng ah lung ngai uhite.

title: JESU MIN KIVOP JING IN
lyrics:
1. Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
I-ngai Pakai Jesu min,
Na che na hung le na chan’a
Sumil hih in Amin ngei.

[CHORUS_START]
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jing in na lung in,
Amin ngei lutah chu,
Kivop jing in niseh in.
[CHORUS_END]

2. Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
A ma chu lum in sung in,
Na chang a nava le na a,
A ma min in tao jing in.

3. Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
Hoichan’a che jong le chun,
A sei thu kigel jing le chun,
Na lung mong jing jeng tante,

4. Jesu min kivop jing in lang,
Hoichan’a um jong le chun,
A thutep theng a kinem in,
Lhaso hih in Amintheng.

title: KILUNGSET KHAOGUI JIN
lyrics:
1. Kilungset khaogui jin,
Christa’n eikan khom cheh,
I-ki golngai nau lungput chu,
Chung gam chon dan ahi.

2. Pa Laltouna ang ah,
I-taonau lhung sap cheh,
Lungtup le kinep na thakhat,
I-lung mon nau jong khat.

3. Gim genthei thoh khom’a,
Pohgih kingai jang toa,
Khat in khat kihu to cheh hi,
Christian kilungset na.

4. I-kikhen nung teng le,
I-ti lunghel um tam?
Hi jong le ilung kikhen lou,
Kimu kit kinem’a.
